/* ==== WEATHER‑01 (GATE‑86) · WeatherState אחד לכל המשחק — השלב הראשון (ענף boats, ‏8.11) =====================================================
   מצב מזג אוויר אחד: clear / cloudy / rain / wind, עם seed ומעבר רך בין מצבים, ומשקלים לפי העונה (קיץ / חורף — window.__TC_WINTER, כמו המראה של החורף).
   השעון: השעון של המשחק (gameClock). כל 3 שעות משחק — מצב חדש מה-seed, והמעבר אליו נמשך שעה וחצי של משחק. אין ציור של גשם עדיין (השלב הראשון — השפעה

var WEATHER=(function(){

  W={summer:{clear:.62,cloudy:.22,rain:.04,wind:.12},winter:{clear:.3,cloudy:.3,rain:.25,wind:.15}},
  WIND={clear:[4,10],cloudy:[7,14],rain:[12,22],wind:[20,32]},CLOUD={clear:.08,cloudy:.7,rain:.95,wind:.45},RAIN={clear:0,cloudy:0,rain:1,wind:.15};
 const ST={seed:20261108,override:null};
 const rnd=(a,b)=>{let h=Math.imul(ST.seed^Math.imul(a+1,2654435761),1597334677)^Math.imul(b+7,374761393);h=Math.imul(h^(h>>>15),2246822507);h=Math.imul(h^(h>>>13),3266489909);return((h^(h>>>16))>>>0)/4294967296};

 /* המצב בזמן מוחלט של המשחק (שעות מתחילת יום 1): המצב של המשבצת, ומעבר רך מהמשבצת הקודמת בתחילתה */
 function atAbs(H,sea){sea=sea||season();const i=Math.floor(H/SEG),f=(H-i*SEG)/SEG,cur=slot(i,sea),prev=slot(i-1,sea),u=Math.min(1,f*SEG/BLEND),e=u*u*(3-2*u),mix=(a,b)=>a+(b-a)*e;
  let d=cur.dir-prev.dir;d=Math.atan2(Math.sin(d),Math.cos(d));
  return{kind:e<.5?prev.kind:cur.kind,next:cur.kind,from:prev.kind,t:+e.toFixed(3),wind:+mix(prev.wind,cur.wind).toFixed(1),dir:prev.dir+d*e,cloud:+mix(prev.cloud,cur.cloud).toFixed(2),rain:+mix(prev.rain,cur.rain).toFixed(2),season:sea,he:HE[e<.5?prev.kind:cur.kind],slot:i,seed:ST.seed}}

 function audit(){const out=[];let bad=0,jump=0;for(let H=0;H<24*14;H+=.25){const a=atAbs(H),b=atAbs(H+.25);if(!KINDS.includes(a.kind))bad++;if(Math.abs(a.wind-b.wind)>6)jump++}

/* ==== D‑572 · יום ולילה מהשעון (ענף world, ‏8.11) ==================================================================================
   ערך הלילה (window.__TC_NIGHT, ‏0…1) נגזר מהשעה במשחק (gameClock) — במדרגות של 1/8 (WLD.steps): המטמונים של הקרקע (האריחים, wtcInvalidate)

// fast — יום שלם בדקה (×48), ‏rate1 — המהירות הרגילה
function wldGo(k){const K=WLD.sky,S=wldSun(+window.__TC_WINTER||0),set=m=>{m=((Math.round(m)%1440)+1440)%1440;gameClockSet(Math.floor(m/60),m%60)},rate=r=>{const C=G84_CLOCK;gameClock();const w=g84WorldS(),m=C.base+w*C.rate;C.rate=.5*r;C.base=m-w*C.rate};

 audit:()=>{const out={ok:true,issues:[]};for(const sea of [0,1]){const S=wldSun(sea);let prev=null,jumps=0,steps=0;for(let m=0;m<1440;m+=.5){const a=wldSkyAt(m,sea);if(prev){if(Math.abs(a.night-prev.night)>.05)jumps++;if(Math.round(a.night*8)!==Math.round(prev.night*8))steps++}prev=a}
   const atSet=wldSkyAt(S.set,sea).night,atRise=wldSkyAt(S.rise,sea).night,noon=wldSkyAt(720,sea).night,mid=wldSkyAt(0,sea).night;

function wxH(a,b,c){let h=Math.imul(a^0x9e3779b9,2654435761)^Math.imul(b+0x7f4a7c15,1597334677)^Math.imul(c|0,374761393);h=Math.imul(h^(h>>>15),2246822507);h=Math.imul(h^(h>>>13),3266489909);return((h^(h>>>16))>>>0)/4294967296}
// העונה לפי לוח הימים: H — שעות מתחילת יום 1; מחזור של 14 יום; 0 קיץ … 1 חורף
function wxSeasonAt(H){const c=((H%336)+336)%336,r=u=>wldSmooth(u);if(c<12)return 1-r((c+12)/24);if(c<156)return 0;if(c<180)return r((c-156)/24);if(c<324)return 1;return 1-r((c-324)/24)}
function wxSeasonDay(day){const d=(((day-1)%14)+14)%14;return d<7?{sea:0,n:d+1}:{sea:1,n:d-6}}   // היום בעונה (1…7)

// כל 200 אלפיות (מ-wldTick): העונה (המדרגה), המצב מ-WEATHER, והערכים שרואים — מתקרבים אליו בהדרגה
function wxTick(now){try{const dt=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(now-WXV.last)/1000));WXV.last=now;

 const k=1-Math.exp(-dt/2.2);V.cloud+=(T.cloud-V.cloud)*k;V.rain+=(T.rain-V.rain)*k;V.wind+=(T.wind-V.wind)*k;let dd=T.dir-V.dir;dd=Math.atan2(Math.sin(dd),Math.cos(dd));V.dir+=dd*k;

/* ===== the terminal E3 by the owner's rule (D‑598, 14:27 / 14:29): every line has 2 places (its boarding bay and its bay behind it, back to back),

   never more than 3 of a line, the third in a reserve); the waiting is in the terminal, never on its roads. In by the gate of the map's path (the west
   gate, or the yard gate for line 1 clockwise), out by the gate of the next trip (the yard gate; the west gate for line 1 anticlockwise). Inside — the
   terminal's own one-way roads (TERM.segs / succ), with the bodies of the other vehicles. ===== */

function lnAdvance(){if(LN.bus.some(b=>b.ph==='adv'||b.ph==='dep'))return;

  for(const lane in L.lanes){const order=L.lanes[lane].map(p=>LN.slots.find(s=>s.line===L.id&&s.lane===lane&&s.pos===p));if(LN.bus.some(b=>b.v&&b.slot&&b.slot.lane===lane))continue;   /* מישהו בדרך לנתיב הזה */
   for(let j=1;j<order.length;j++){const sl=order[j];if(!sl.bus)continue;let k=j;while(k>0&&!order[k-1].bus)k--;if(k===j)continue;const B=LN.bus.find(b=>b.id===sl.bus);if(!B||B.v||B.ph!=='park')continue;
    const to=order[k],v=lnMakeVeh(B);B.v=v;lnHide(B,true);TRAFFIC_CARS.push(v);to.bus=B.id;sl.bus=null;B.slot=to;B.retire=false;B.deadhead=false;B.target=null;B.at=null;lnSetPath(B,lgPath([[sl.x,sl.y],[to.x,to.y]]),'adv');lnLog(B.no+' moves up from '+sl.key+' to '+to.key);return}}}}

/* המהירות שמותרת לאוטובוס לפני הולך: האטה (LB_DEC) עד עצירה 0.8 מ׳ לפני מי שנמצא ברצועת הנתיב שלפניו, או שיהיה בה כשהאוטובוס יגיע */
function lbxCap(B){const P=B.path,v=B.v;if(!P||!v)return Infinity;const peds=lbxPeds();if(!peds.length)return Infinity;const L2=TERM.L/2,sp=v.speed||0,look=L2+sp*sp/(2*LB_DEC)+44;let best=Infinity;
 for(let d=L2-4;d<=look&&best===Infinity;d+=6){const s=B.s+d;if(s>P.total)break;const p=lgAt(P,s),tb=Math.max(0,d-L2)/Math.max(sp,14);
  for(const q of peds){const th=Math.min(q.th,tb+.8),ex=q.vx*th,ey=q.vy*th,L=ex*ex+ey*ey;let u=L>1e-6?((p.x-q.x)*ex+(p.y-q.y)*ey)/L:0;u=u<0?0:u>1?1:u;if(Math.hypot(p.x-(q.x+ex*u),p.y-(q.y+ey*u))<22){best=d-L2;break}}}
 return best===Infinity?Infinity:best<8?0:Math.sqrt(2*LB_DEC*(best-8))}
/* האוטובוסים שנוסעים בתוך המסוף, עם הנקודות שלפניהם על המסלול (פעם אחת בכל צעד) */
function lbxBuses(){if(LBX.bt===LN.t)return LBX.bl;const out=[],L2=TERM.L/2;for(const B of LN.bus){const v=B.v;if(!v||!B.path||(B.ph!=='tin'&&B.ph!=='tout'))continue;const sp=v.speed||0,pts=[];
  for(let d=-L2;d<=L2+14+sp*1.6;d+=8){const s=B.s+d;if(s<0)continue;if(s>B.path.total)break;const p=lgAt(B.path,s);pts.push(p.x,p.y)}out.push(pts)}
 LBX.bt=LN.t;LBX.bl=out;return out}
/* ההולך מחכה: הצעד הבא שלו נכנס אל הדרך של אוטובוס שמגיע (ומי שכבר שם — ממשיך ומפנה) */
function lbxHold(n){const t=n.targets[Math.min(n.stage,n.targets.length-1)],dx=t.x-n.x,dy=t.y-n.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(d<1)return false;const ax=n.x,ay=n.y,bx=n.x+dx/d*Math.min(d,18),by=n.y+dy/d*Math.min(d,18);
 for(const pts of lbxBuses()){let inA=false,inB=false;for(let i=0;i<pts.length;i+=2){const x=pts[i],y=pts[i+1];if(!inA&&Math.hypot(ax-x,ay-y)<19)inA=true;if(!inB&&Math.hypot(bx-x,by-y)<19)inB=true}if(inB&&!inA)return true}return false}
function lbxTick(dt){if(!LN.seeded)return;
 for(const L of LN_LINES){let st=null,q=null;try{st=BUS_TERMINAL_STOPS[L.line];q=busPassengerStop(st.id)}catch(e){}if(!q)continue;const on=lbLineOn(L),S=LBX.seen;
  if(S[L.id]==null)S[L.id]=q.waiting;
  if(on&&q.waiting>S[L.id]){const k=q.waiting-S[L.id];q.waiting=S[L.id];for(let i=0;i<k;i++)lbxArrive(L,st,stableHash(st.id+':'+LBX.n.walkIn+':'+i)%240)}   /* מי ש"הופיע" ברציף — בא ברגל, ונספר כשיגיע */
  S[L.id]=q.waiting}
 for(const n of BUS_ALIGHTERS){if(!n.lbx||n.delay>0)continue;
  if(n.lbxArr){const t=n.targets[n.targets.length-1];if(n.stage>=n.targets.length-1&&Math.hypot(t.x-n.x,t.y-n.y)<3){const a=n.lbxArr;n.lbxArr=null;LBX.n.arrived++;try{const L=LN_LINES.find(l=>l.id===a.line),q=busPassengerStop(a.id);if(L&&q&&lbLineOn(L)){q.waiting=Math.min(BUS_STOP_WAIT_MAX,q.waiting+1);LBX.seen[L.id]=q.waiting}}catch(e){}}}
  if(lbxHold(n)){if(!n.lbxW)LBX.n.pedWait++;n.hold=.12;n.lbxW=1;LBX.n.pedWaitS+=dt}else n.lbxW=0}}
/* ==== BUS-STUDIO · D‑625 (10.11.2026): האוטובוס העירוני מהסטודיו של הבעלים — לכל האוטובוסים של קווים 1, 2, 3, 4 ו-6 (בלי פרסומות — D‑626) ==== */

  function tex(kind, o, ts) {
    const key = kind + '|' + o.col + '|' + (o.side || 0) + '|' + (o.night ? 1 : 0) + '|' + (kind === 'side' && o.side === 1 ? (+o.door || 0).toFixed(2) : '') + '|' + ts.toFixed(3);
    let e = TEX.get(key); if (e) { TEX.delete(key); TEX.set(key, e); return e }
    const w = kind === 'side' ? 1200 : 255, h = kind === 'side' ? 319 : 296, cv = mk(w * ts, h * ts), g = cv.getContext('2d');
    g.setTransform(cv.width / w, 0, 0, cv.height / h, 0, 0); g.lineJoin = 'round';
    (kind === 'side' ? sideTex : kind === 'front' ? frontTex : rearTex)(g, Object.assign({}, o, { ts }));
    e = { cv, w, h }; TEX.set(key, e); TEXB += cv.width * cv.height * 4;
    while (TEXB > BXP.texMB * 1048576 && TEX.size > 1) { const [k0, e0] = TEX.entries().next().value; TEX.delete(k0); TEXB -= e0.cv.width * e0.cv.height * 4 }
    return e }

  // ---------- the nose and the tail: the panels of the shell (the studio's grid), each an affine piece of the texture ----------
  const UV = [0, 3, 8, 15, 25, 40, 85, 127.5, 170, 215, 230, 240, 247, 252, 255], VV = [0, 55, 130, 200, 260, 296];
  function expanded(tri) { const n = tri.length, E = tri.map((p, i) => { const q = tri[(i + 1) % n], nx = q[1] - p[1], ny = p[0] - q[0], len = Math.hypot(nx, ny); return [nx, ny, nx * p[0] + ny * p[1] + .8 * len] });
    return E.map((a, i) => { const b = E[(i + n - 1) % n], d = a[0] * b[1] - b[0] * a[1]; return [(a[2] * b[1] - b[2] * a[1]) / d, (a[0] * b[2] - b[0] * a[2]) / d] }) }
  // the affine map of texture (u, v) → world screen (x, y) through three points of the shell
  function affine(tri, Pw, point) { const [a, b, c] = tri, [u0, v0] = a, [u1, v1] = b, [u2, v2] = c, [x0, y0] = Pw(...point(u0, v0)), [x1, y1] = Pw(...point(u1, v1)), [x2, y2] = Pw(...point(u2, v2)), d = (u1 - u0) * (v2 - v0) - (u2 - u0) * (v1 - v0);
    const A = ((x1 - x0) * (v2 - v0) - (x2 - x0) * (v1 - v0)) / d, B = ((y1 - y0) * (v2 - v0) - (y2 - y0) * (v1 - v0)) / d, C = ((u1 - u0) * (x2 - x0) - (u2 - u0) * (x1 - x0)) / d, D = ((u1 - u0) * (y2 - y0) - (u2 - u0) * (y1 - y0)) / d;
    return [A, B, C, D, x0 - A * u0 - C * v0, y0 - B * u0 - D * v0] }
  function shellPanels(front, cs, sn, Pw, queue, texE, sunOv) {
    const point = front ? nosePoint : tailPoint;
    for (let i = 0; i < UV.length - 1; i++) for (let j = 0; j < VV.length - 1; j++) {
      const u0 = UV[i], u1 = UV[i + 1], v0 = VV[j], v1 = VV[j + 1], a = point(u0, (v0 + v1) / 2), b = point(u1, (v0 + v1) / 2), dxdy = (b[0] - a[0]) / (b[1] - a[1]);
      let visv; if (front) { const rake = 4.8 * ((a[2] + b[2]) / 2) / H ** 2; visv = K * (sn - dxdy * cs) + rake } else { const y = (a[1] + b[1]) / 2, z = (a[2] + b[2]) / 2, rake = (tailX(y, z + .01) - tailX(y, z - .01)) / .02; visv = K * (-sn + dxdy * cs) + rake }
      if (visv < .0001) continue;
      const panels = j === 0 && (i < 3 || i > 10) ? [[[u0, v0], [u1, v0], [u1, v1]], [[u0, v0], [u1, v1], [u0, v1]]] : [[[u0, v0], [u1, v0], [u1, v1], [u0, v1]]];
      for (const tri of panels) {
        const world = tri.map(p => point(...p)), depth = world.reduce((s, p) => s + K * (p[0] * sn + p[1] * cs) + p[2], 0) / tri.length, ym = (world[0][1] + world[1][1]) / 2;
        // the normal of the piece (outward), for the sun of the game
        const e1 = [world[1][0] - world[0][0], world[1][1] - world[0][1], world[1][2] - world[0][2]], e2 = [world[2][0] - world[0][0], world[2][1] - world[0][1], world[2][2] - world[0][2]];
        let n = [e1[1] * e2[2] - e1[2] * e2[1], e1[2] * e2[0] - e1[0] * e2[2], e1[0] * e2[1] - e1[1] * e2[0]]; const nl = Math.hypot(...n) || 1; n = n.map(q => q / nl); if ((front ? 1 : -1) * n[0] < 0) n = n.map(q => -q);
        const shade = .04 + .16 * Math.abs(ym) / HW, M = affine(tri, Pw, point), clip = expanded(tri), ov = sunOv([n[0] * cs - n[1] * sn, n[0] * sn + n[1] * cs, n[2]]);
        queue(depth, g => { g.save(); g.transform(...M); g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(clip[0][0], clip[0][1]); for (let q = 1; q < clip.length; q++) g.lineTo(clip[q][0], clip[q][1]); g.closePath(); g.clip();
          g.drawImage(texE.cv, 0, 0, texE.cv.width, texE.cv.height, 0, 0, 255, 296); g.globalAlpha = shade; g.fillStyle = '#082534'; g.fillRect(0, 0, 255, 296);
          if (ov) { g.globalAlpha = ov[1]; g.fillStyle = ov[0]; g.fillRect(0, 0, 255, 296) } g.restore() }) } } }

  // ---------- one picture ----------
  function sprite(o) {
    const N = o.N || 32, k = ((o.k % N) + N) % N, th = k / N * Math.PI * 2, cs = Math.cos(th), sn = Math.sin(th), res = o.res || 1, col = o.col || '#ee7d2d', night = !!o.night, door = clamp(+o.door || 0, 0, 1);
    const wx = (x, y) => x * cs - y * sn, wy = (x, y, z) => x * sn + y * cs - K * z;
    let x0b = 1e9, x1b = -1e9, y0b = 1e9, y1b = -1e9; const grow = (x, y) => { if (x < x0b) x0b = x; if (x > x1b) x1b = x; if (y < y0b) y0b = y; if (y > y1b) y1b = y };
    for (const x of [-60.5, 60.5]) for (const y of [-12.9, 12.9]) for (const z of [0, TOP + .3]) { grow(wx(x, y), wy(x, y, z)); grow(wx(x, y) + SUN.x * z, x * sn + y * cs + SUN.y * z) }
    for (const x of [50, 57]) for (const y of [-18.6, 18.6]) for (const z of [18.5, 29.2]) grow(wx(x, y), wy(x, y, z));   // the mirrors on their arms
    const mg = 1.4 + 2 / res; x0b -= mg; y0b -= mg; x1b += mg; y1b += mg;
    const ox = Math.ceil(-x0b * res), oy = Math.ceil(-y0b * res), cv = mk((x1b - x0b) * res + 1, (y1b - y0b) * res + 1), g = cv.getContext('2d');
    g.imageSmoothingEnabled = true; g.lineJoin = 'round';
    const Pw = (x, y, z) => [wx(x, y), wy(x, y, z || 0)], base = () => g.setTransform(res, 0, 0, res, ox, oy);
    const ts = Math.min(.42, res * .14);   // the textures: ~1.4 device px per world px along the bus (sharp at every density)
    // the sun of the game on a face (n — the world normal): a dark veil or a light one, like the 3/4 vehicles (C34: litK)
    const sunOv = n => { const b = litK(n), t = .55; return b < 1 ? ['#0e1116', Math.min(.45, (1 - b) * t)] : ['#ffffff', Math.min(.2, (b - 1) * .6 * t)] };
    // 1 · the shadow (the game's sun: the hull of the body on the ground and its top moved by SUN·z; half density, soft) — as C34 renderKit
    { const hw2 = Math.ceil(cv.width / 2) + 2, hh2 = Math.ceil(cv.height / 2) + 2, S = mk(hw2, hh2), s = S.getContext('2d'); s.setTransform(.5, 0, 0, .5, 0, 0);
      const sp = (x, y, z) => [ox + res * (wx(x, y) + SUN.x * z), oy + res * (x * sn + y * cs + SUN.y * z)], P = [];
      for (const x of [-59, 59]) for (const y of [-12.6, 12.6]) { P.push(sp(x, y, 0)); P.push(sp(x * .97, y * .92, H)) }
      const hl = hull(P); s.beginPath(); s.moveTo(hl[0][0], hl[0][1]); for (const q of hl) s.lineTo(q[0], q[1]); s.closePath(); s.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.24)'; s.fill();
      s.beginPath(); for (const ax of [-39.6, 36]) for (const sg of [-1, 1]) { const c0 = [ox + res * wx(ax, sg * 10.55), oy + res * wy(ax, sg * 10.55, 0)]; s.moveTo(c0[0] + 5.1 * res * 1.1 * cs, c0[1] + 5.1 * res * 1.1 * sn); s.ellipse(c0[0], c0[1], 5.1 * res * 1.1, 3.4 * res * .9, th, 0, 7) } s.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.25)'; s.fill();
      g.save(); try { g.filter = 'blur(' + (.75 * res).toFixed(2) + 'px)' } catch (e) { } g.drawImage(S, 0, 0, hw2, hh2, 0, 0, hw2 * 2, hh2 * 2); g.restore() }
    const items = []; const queue = (d, f) => items.push({ d, f });
    // 2 · the tyres and the rims (the original axles)
    for (const x of [-39.6, 36]) for (const side of [-1, 1]) { const y = side * 12.65; if (!(side * cs > -.02)) continue;
      queue(K * (x * sn + y * cs) + 5.1, g => { const p = Pw(x, y, 5.1); g.transform(cs * .1, sn * .1, 0, -K * .1, p[0], p[1]); wheelFace(g, 0) }) }
    // 3 · the sides
    for (const side of [1, -1]) { if (!(side * cs > .0001)) continue; const y = side * HW, T = tex('side', { col, side, night, door: side === 1 ? door : 0 }, ts), ov = sunOv([-side * sn, side * cs, 0]);
      queue(K * (HW * Math.abs(cs)) + H / 2, g => { const p = Pw(-L / 2, y, H); g.transform(cs * .1, sn * .1, 0, K * .1, p[0], p[1]); g.drawImage(T.cv, 0, 0, T.cv.width, T.cv.height, 0, 0, 1200, 319);
        if (ov) { g.globalAlpha = ov[1]; g.fillStyle = ov[0]; g.fill(pth(BASE)); g.globalAlpha = 1 } }) }
    // 4 · the nose and the tail
    shellPanels(true, cs, sn, Pw, (d, f) => queue(d, f), tex('front', { col, night }, ts * 1.6), sunOv);
    shellPanels(false, cs, sn, Pw, (d, f) => queue(d, f), tex('rear', { col, night }, ts * 1.6), sunOv);
    // 5 · the mirrors (two, on raised arms)
    for (const side of [-1, 1]) { const yc = side * (side === 1 ? 18.2 : 17.2), mx0 = 54.7, mx1 = 56.5, my0 = yc - 1.35, my1 = yc + 1.35, z0 = side === 1 ? 18.9 : 20.1, z1 = 25.9, dep = (x, y, z) => K * (x * sn + y * cs) + z;
      queue(dep(53, yc, 27.1), g => { const pts = [Pw(50.2, side * 12.4, 26.9), Pw(51.6, side * 16.1, 28.7), Pw(54.3, yc, 27.9), Pw(55.6, yc, 25.2)]; g.lineCap = 'round'; for (const [c, w, a] of [['#11202a', .72, 1], ['#8ba0aa', .16, .8]]) { g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(...pts[0]); g.quadraticCurveTo(...pts[1], ...pts[2]); g.lineTo(...pts[3]); g.globalAlpha = a; g.strokeStyle = c; g.lineWidth = w; g.stroke() } g.globalAlpha = 1 });
      if (Math.abs(sn) > .0001) { const fr = sn > 0, x = fr ? mx1 : mx0;
        queue(dep(x, yc, (z0 + z1) / 2), g => { const p = Pw(x, my0, z1); g.transform(-sn, cs, 0, K, p[0], p[1]); g.fillStyle = '#0b1720'; g.fill(rr(0, 0, 2.7, z1 - z0, .48)); g.strokeStyle = '#344956'; g.lineWidth = .12; g.stroke(rr(0, 0, 2.7, z1 - z0, .48));
          if (fr) strokeP(g, 'M.5 .7Q1.4 .3 2.2 .7', '#7f949d', .15); else { g.fillStyle = linBox(g, .25, .35, 2.2, z1 - z0 - .7, 0, 0, 1, 1, [[0, '#476476'], [.48, '#adc9d0'], [.5, '#587786'], [1, '#203d4e']]); g.fill(rr(.25, .35, 2.2, z1 - z0 - .7, .3)); fillP(g, new Path2D(`M.5 .65L1.8 .5 .8 ${z1 - z0 - 1}H.45Z`), '#e3f2f4', .25) } }) }
      const ys = cs > 0 ? my1 : my0;
      queue(dep((mx0 + mx1) / 2, ys, (z0 + z1) / 2), g => polyW(g, Pw, [[mx0, ys, z0], [mx1, ys, z0], [mx1, ys, z1], [mx0, ys, z1]], '#182c38', '#6f8792', .08));
      queue(dep((mx0 + mx1) / 2, yc, z1), g => polyW(g, Pw, [[mx0, my0, z1], [mx1, my0, z1], [mx1, my1, z1], [mx0, my1, z1]], '#354e5b', '#7c939c', .08)) }
    items.sort((a, b) => a.d - b.d); for (const it of items) { base(); g.save(); it.f(g); g.restore() }
    // 6 · the roof — white, always (D‑625), as one layer over everything: the shell, the rounded edges, the air conditioners, the seams
    base(); roof(g, Pw, cs, sn, night);
    return { cv, ox, oy, res, k, N, bytes: cv.width * cv.height * 4 };
  }
  function polyW(g, Pw, pts, fill, stroke, sw) { g.beginPath(); pts.forEach((p, i) => { const q = Pw(...p); if (i) g.lineTo(q[0], q[1]); else g.moveTo(q[0], q[1]) }); g.closePath(); if (fill) { g.fillStyle = fill; g.fill() } if (stroke) { g.strokeStyle = stroke; g.lineWidth = sw; g.stroke() } }
  function hull(pts) { const P = pts.slice().sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0] || a[1] - b[1]), cr = (o, a, b) => (a[0] - o[0]) * (b[1] - o[1]) - (a[1] - o[1]) * (b[0] - o[0]), lo = [], up = [];
    for (const p of P) { while (lo.length >= 2 && cr(lo[lo.length - 2], lo[lo.length - 1], p) <= 0) lo.pop(); lo.push(p) } for (let i = P.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const p = P[i]; while (up.length >= 2 && cr(up[up.length - 2], up[up.length - 1], p) <= 0) up.pop(); up.push(p) }
    up.pop(); lo.pop(); return lo.concat(up) }
  // the roof gradient: vertical over the box of each piece on the screen (the studio's objectBoundingBox), white by day; the night of the
  // game darkens it (the veil) — so no night tint of its own
  const ROOF = [[0, '#edf0ec'], [.4, '#ffffff'], [1, '#aab6bc']];
  function roofPoly(g, Pw, pts, stroke, sw) { const Q = pts.map(p => Pw(...p)); let y0 = 1e9, y1 = -1e9, x0 = 1e9, x1 = -1e9; for (const q of Q) { y0 = Math.min(y0, q[1]); y1 = Math.max(y1, q[1]); x0 = Math.min(x0, q[0]); x1 = Math.max(x1, q[0]) }
    g.beginPath(); Q.forEach((q, i) => i ? g.lineTo(q[0], q[1]) : g.moveTo(q[0], q[1])); g.closePath(); g.fillStyle = linBox(g, x0, y0, Math.max(.01, x1 - x0), Math.max(.01, y1 - y0), 0, 0, 0, 1, ROOF); g.fill(); g.strokeStyle = stroke; g.lineWidth = sw; g.stroke() }
  function roof(g, Pw, cs, sn, night) {
    const central = [...UV.map(u => { const y = clamp((u - 127.5) * .1, -11.15, 11.15); return [tailX(y, H), y, H] }), ...UV.map(u => { const y = clamp((127.5 - u) * .1, -11.15, 11.15); return [noseX(y, H), y, H] })];
    roofPoly(g, Pw, central, '#8ba2a8', .1);
    for (const side of [-1, 1]) for (const [ya, yb] of [[11.15, 11.75], [11.75, 12.35], [12.35, 12.75]]) { const a = ya * side, b = yb * side;
      roofPoly(g, Pw, [[tailX(a, roofZ(a)), a, roofZ(a)], [noseX(a, roofZ(a)), a, roofZ(a)], [noseX(b, roofZ(b)), b, roofZ(b)], [tailX(b, roofZ(b)), b, roofZ(b)]], '#7d999f', .05) }
    const box = (x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1) => { const a = [];
      a.push({ d: z1 + K * ((x0 + x1) / 2 * sn + (y0 + y1) / 2 * cs), p: [[x0, y0, z1], [x1, y0, z1], [x1, y1, z1], [x0, y1, z1]], f: '#e3e8e6', s: '#71858d', w: .1 });
      if (cs > 0) a.push({ d: (z0 + z1) / 2 + K * ((x0 + x1) / 2 * sn + y1 * cs), p: [[x0, y1, z0], [x1, y1, z0], [x1, y1, z1], [x0, y1, z1]], f: '#9bafb5', s: '#5a727e', w: .08 });
      if (cs < 0) a.push({ d: (z0 + z1) / 2 + K * ((x0 + x1) / 2 * sn + y0 * cs), p: [[x0, y0, z0], [x1, y0, z0], [x1, y0, z1], [x0, y0, z1]], f: '#bccbd0', s: '#71858d', w: .08 });
      if (sn > 0) a.push({ d: (z0 + z1) / 2 + K * (x1 * sn + (y0 + y1) / 2 * cs), p: [[x1, y0, z0], [x1, y1, z0], [x1, y1, z1], [x1, y0, z1]], f: '#b1c2c6', s: '#71858d', w: .08 });
      if (sn < 0) a.push({ d: (z0 + z1) / 2 + K * (x0 * sn + (y0 + y1) / 2 * cs), p: [[x0, y0, z0], [x0, y1, z0], [x0, y1, z1], [x0, y0, z1]], f: '#8ba0a9', s: '#71858d', w: .08 });
      a.sort((m, n) => m.d - n.d); for (const q of a) polyW(g, Pw, q.p, q.f, q.s, q.w) };
    const units = [[-21, 13, -7, 7, TOP], [-46, -32, -6.5, 6.5, H + .55], [26, 41, -6.5, 6.5, H + .5]];
    units.sort((a, b) => ((a[0] + a[1]) - (b[0] + b[1])) * sn);
    for (const [x0, x1, y0, y1, z1] of units) { box(x0, x1, y0, y1, H, z1); g.beginPath(); for (let x = x0 + 1.2; x < x1 - .5; x += 1.2) { const a = Pw(x, y0 + 1, z1 + .02), b = Pw(x, y1 - 1, z1 + .02); g.moveTo(a[0], a[1]); g.lineTo(b[0], b[1]) } g.strokeStyle = '#718890'; g.lineWidth = .17; g.lineCap = 'round'; g.stroke() }
    g.beginPath(); for (const yy of [-10.7, 10.7]) { const a = Pw(-55, yy, H + .04), b = Pw(55, yy, H + .04); g.moveTo(a[0], a[1]); g.lineTo(b[0], b[1]) } g.strokeStyle = '#ffffff'; g.lineWidth = .14; g.stroke();
  }
  // the wheel face in its own plane (unit = 0.1 world px; the tyre r 51), turned by a (rad) — the studio's tyre, rim, ten bolts, hub
  function wheelFace(g, a) {
    g.fillStyle = '#0e1419'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(0, 0, 51, 0, 6.2832); g.fill(); g.strokeStyle = '#04090b'; g.lineWidth = 3; g.stroke();
    g.fillStyle = '#17232d'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(0, 0, 46, 0, 6.2832); g.fill(); g.strokeStyle = '#394751'; g.lineWidth = 2; g.stroke();
    const rim = g.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 36); for (const [o, c] of [[0, '#566670'], [.2, '#e7ecee'], [.63, '#6d7f89'], [.82, '#f8fbfc'], [1, '#4c606c']]) rim.addColorStop(o, c);
    g.fillStyle = rim; g.beginPath(); g.arc(0, 0, 36, 0, 6.2832); g.fill(); g.strokeStyle = '#a4b5be'; g.lineWidth = 1.5; g.stroke();
    g.fillStyle = '#71848f'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(0, 0, 26, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();
    g.fillStyle = '#26343f'; g.beginPath(); for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) { const b = a + i * Math.PI / 5, x = Math.cos(b) * 20, y = Math.sin(b) * 20; g.moveTo(x + 2.7, y); g.arc(x, y, 2.7, 0, 6.2832) } g.fill();
    const ch = g.createLinearGradient(-13, -13, 13, 13); for (const [o, c] of [[0, '#e6eef0'], [.32, '#7f939d'], [.5, '#f8fbfa'], [.73, '#566773'], [1, '#b5c5cb']]) ch.addColorStop(o, c);
    g.fillStyle = ch; g.beginPath(); g.arc(0, 0, 13, 0, 6.2832); g.fill(); g.fillStyle = '#778c99'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(0, 0, 6, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();
    g.strokeStyle = '#65737c'; g.lineWidth = 2; g.stroke(pth('M-36-24A44 44 0 0 1 28-34'));
  }
  // a turning wheel for the game (24 steps of 15°): a 64 × 64 picture, the tyre radius = 30 px
  const WS = new Map();
  function wheelSprite(step) { let c = WS.get(step); if (c) return c; c = mk(64, 64); const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.setTransform(30 / 51, 0, 0, 30 / 51, 32, 32); wheelFace(g, step / 24 * Math.PI * 2); WS.set(step, c); return c }

  // ---------- the stickers: the LED text, the serial number ----------
  // the LED: number (big, at the right end) and the destination (the studio's led()); w × h units at (x, y) of its face; mirror — the left side
  const STK = new Map(); let STKB = 0;
  function stk(key, w, h, ts, draw) { let e = STK.get(key); if (e) { STK.delete(key); STK.set(key, e); return e }
    const m = 9, cv = mk((w + 2 * m) * ts, (h + 2 * m) * ts), g = cv.getContext('2d'); g.setTransform(ts, 0, 0, ts, m * ts, m * ts); draw(g);
    e = { cv, m, w, h }; STK.set(key, e); STKB += cv.width * cv.height * 4; while (STK.size > 400 || STKB > 4 * 1048576) { const [k0, e0] = STK.entries().next().value; STK.delete(k0); STKB -= e0.cv.width * e0.cv.height * 4 } return e }
  const FONT = '"Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif';
  function fitText(g, s, size, maxW) { g.font = '700 ' + size.toFixed(2) + 'px ' + FONT; let t = String(s || ''); while (t.length > 2 && g.measureText(t).width > maxW) t = t.slice(0, -1); return t }
  function sign(face, num, txt, night, ts) {
    const D = face === 'rear' ? [135, 29] : face === 'front' ? [211, 35] : [205, 38], w = D[0], h = D[1], mir = face === 'left';
    return stk('L|' + face + '|' + num + '|' + (txt || '') + '|' + (night ? 1 : 0) + '|' + ts.toFixed(3), w, h, ts, g => {
      const col = night ? '#ffe693' : '#efbd53';
      const draw = () => { g.save(); if (mir) { g.translate(w, 0); g.scale(-1, 1) } g.fillStyle = col; g.textAlign = 'center'; g.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
        g.font = '700 ' + (h * .72).toFixed(2) + 'px ' + FONT; g.fillText(String(num), w - 19, h * .75);
        if (txt) { g.direction = 'rtl'; const t = fitText(g, txt, h * .43, w - 46); g.fillText(t, w * .43, h * .71) } g.restore() };
      if (night) glow(g, ts, draw); else draw() }) }
  // the serial number: on the side (light, by the rear wheel), on the back (under the window), on the roof (big, dark — read from the air)
  function serialStk(kind, s, ts) {
    if (kind === 'roofX') return stk('S|roofX|' + s + '|' + ts.toFixed(3), 22, 12, ts, g => { g.globalAlpha = .88; g.fillStyle = '#26333c'; g.textAlign = 'center'; g.textBaseline = 'middle'; g.font = '700 8.6px ' + FONT; g.fillText(String(s), 11, 6.5) });
    if (kind === 'roofA') return stk('S|roofA|' + s + '|' + ts.toFixed(3), 12.6, 8.4, ts, g => { g.globalAlpha = .88; g.fillStyle = '#26333c'; g.textAlign = 'center'; g.textBaseline = 'middle'; g.font = '700 7px ' + FONT; g.fillText(String(s), 6.3, 4.6) });
    const sz = kind === 'rear' ? 14 : 17, w = sz * 3.2, h = sz * 1.3;   // kind: 'side' (the right side), 'left' (mirrored, as the studio's left side), 'rear'
    return stk('S|' + kind + '|' + s + '|' + ts.toFixed(3), w, h, ts, g => { if (kind === 'left') { g.translate(w, 0); g.scale(-1, 1) } g.fillStyle = kind === 'rear' ? '#f7f3dd' : '#f3f5df'; g.textAlign = 'center'; g.textBaseline = 'alphabetic'; g.font = '700 ' + sz + 'px Arial, sans-serif'; g.fillText(String(s), w / 2, h * .8) }) }
  // where the stickers go for direction k: [a, b, c, d, e, f] — texture units → world px (relative to the ground centre), and the box
  const FC = new Map();
  function faces(k, N) { const key = N + '|' + k; let F = FC.get(key); if (F) return F; const th = k / N * Math.PI * 2, cs = Math.cos(th), sn = Math.sin(th), Pw = (x, y, z) => [x * cs - y * sn, x * sn + y * cs - K * z];
    F = {}; const side = cs > .0001 ? 1 : cs < -.0001 ? -1 : 0;
    if (side) { const p = Pw(-L / 2, side * HW, H); F.side = { s: side, M: [cs * .1, sn * .1, 0, K * .1, p[0], p[1]], led: [side === 1 ? 766 : 355, 41], ser: [1120, 267] } }
    const nose = (a, b, c) => affine([a, b, c], Pw, nosePoint), tail = (a, b, c) => affine([a, b, c], Pw, tailPoint);
    if (sn > .06) F.front = { M: nose([22, 26], [233, 26], [22, 61]), led: [22, 26] };
    if (sn < -.06) F.rear = { M: tail([60, 28], [195, 28], [60, 57]), led: [60, 28], Ms: tail([100, 240], [155, 240], [100, 262]) };
    // the roof number (D‑580): between the middle and the front air conditioners (x 13 … 26); along the bus when the bus lies across the
    // screen, across it when it stands up the screen — always read upright (its x to the right of the screen, its top up)
    { const along = Math.abs(cs) >= .6, c = Pw(19.5, 0, H + .03); let ex = along ? [cs, sn] : [-sn, cs]; if (ex[0] < 0 || (ex[0] === 0 && ex[1] < 0)) ex = [-ex[0], -ex[1]];
      const ey = [-ex[1], ex[0]], kind = along ? 'roofA' : 'roofX', w = along ? 12.6 : 22, h = along ? 8.4 : 12, sc = along ? 1 : .95;
      F.roof = { kind, M: [ex[0] * sc, ex[1] * sc, ey[0] * sc, ey[1] * sc, c[0] - (ex[0] * w / 2 + ey[0] * h / 2) * sc, c[1] - (ex[1] * w / 2 + ey[1] * h / 2) * sc] } }
    if (FC.size > 2000) FC.clear(); FC.set(key, F); return F }
  // all the stickers of one bus over its picture: ctx in world px with the ground centre at (0, 0) (and the small turn of the picture, if
  // any); o = { num (the line), txt (the text of the sign; '' — the sign is off), serial, night, px (device px per world px — the detail by
  // the size on the screen), res }. The calls: the sign of the near side and of the front or the back, the serial on the roof (and on the
  // side and the back up close) — each one drawImage of a small cached picture. Returns how many were drawn.
  function stickers(ctx, k, N, o) {
    const F = faces(k, N), px = o.px || 1, ts = Math.min(.6, Math.max(.12, (o.res || 1) * .16)), night = !!o.night; let n = 0;
    const put = (M, e, x, y, mir) => { ctx.save(); ctx.transform(M[0], M[1], M[2], M[3], M[4], M[5]); if (mir) ctx.transform(-1, 0, 0, 1, 2 * x + e.w, 0); ctx.drawImage(e.cv, x - e.m, y - e.m, e.w + 2 * e.m, e.h + 2 * e.m); ctx.restore(); n++ };
    const lit = o.txt != null && (px >= .7 || night);
    if (lit && F.side) put(F.side.M, sign(F.side.s === 1 ? 'right' : 'left', o.num, o.txt, night, ts), F.side.led[0], F.side.led[1]);
    if (lit && F.front) put(F.front.M, sign('front', o.num, o.txt, night, ts), 22, 26);
    if (lit && F.rear) put(F.rear.M, sign('rear', o.num, '', night, ts), 60, 28);
    if (o.serial != null && px >= .55) { const e = serialStk(F.roof.kind, o.serial, Math.max(.5, ts * 4)); put(F.roof.M, e, 0, 0) }
    if (o.serial != null && px >= 1.7) {
      if (F.side) { const e = serialStk(F.side.s === 1 ? 'side' : 'left', o.serial, ts); put(F.side.M, e, 1120 - e.w / 2, 267 - e.h * .8) }
      if (F.rear) { const e = serialStk('rear', o.serial, ts * 1.6); put(F.rear.Ms, e, 127 - e.w / 2, 254 - e.h * .8) } }
    return n }
  const info = { length: L, width: W, height: H, top: TOP, K, wheels: [{ u: -39.6, r: 5.1, hw: 12.65 }, { u: 36, r: 5.1, hw: 12.65 }],
    lamps: { head: { x: noseX(9.05, 6.575), y: 9.05, z: 6.575 }, tail: { x: tailX(10.35, 16.4), y: 10.35, z: 16.4 }, markers: [-55.2, -29.8, 23.4, 53.3] } };
  const BXP = { sprite, stickers, sign, serial: serialStk, faces, wheelSprite, wheelFace, info, tone, texStats: () => ({ textures: TEX.size, MB: +(TEXB / 1048576).toFixed(2), stickers: STK.size, stickerMB: +(STKB / 1048576).toFixed(2) }),
    clear: () => { TEX.clear(); TEXB = 0; STK.clear(); STKB = 0; FC.clear(); WS.clear() }, texMB: 6, noseX, tailX, nosePoint, tailPoint };
  return BXP;
})();

 function gone(b){const i=F.BOATS.indexOf(b);if(i>=0)F.BOATS.splice(i,1);const j=OWN.indexOf(b);if(j>=0)OWN.splice(j,1);const st=P();st.boats=st.boats.filter(r=>r.id!==b.id);try{delete F.P().boats[b.id]}catch(e){}save('boat-gone')}
 function buy(mid,li,o){live();o=o||{};const m=MOD[mid],st=P();if(!m)return false;const s=freeSlot(m.cls);if(!s)return toast('אין מקום פנוי במעגן שלך ל'+CLS_HE[m.cls]+' — אפשר למכור סירה'),false;
  if(!o.free){if(PlayerProfile.money<m.price)return toast('אין מספיק כסף — "'+m.name+'" עולה '+money(m.price)),false;PlayerProfile.money-=m.price;try{recordTransaction('boat-purchase',-m.price,{model:mid})}catch(e){}}

 function hCanFish(b){if(!b.rods.length)return b.model.type==='jet'?'מאופנוע ים לא דגים':'ב"'+b.name+'" אין ציוד דיג — מתקינים במספנה';if(!licenseOwned('LIC-12'))return 'לדיג העמוק צריך רישיון דיג עמוק — '+(typeof LIC570!=='undefined'?LIC570.missingText():'15 תפיסות באגם ו-10 בחוף');if(keep(b.x,b.y))return 'ליד המעגן לא דגים — יוצאים לים הפתוח';return null}

  if((r.up.elec||0)>=2){let best=null,bd=1e9;for(const s of F.SPOTS){const d=Math.hypot(s.x-b.x,s.y-b.y);if(d<bd){bd=d;best=s}}const far=Math.hypot(b.x-b.be.cx,b.y-b.be.cy)>600,tx=far?b.be.cx:best.x,ty=far?LY:best.y,d=Math.hypot(tx-b.x,ty-b.y),a=Math.round(((Math.atan2(ty-b.y,tx-b.x)+TAU)%TAU)/(Math.PI/4))%8;

 /* ---- המספנה: הזמנת שדרוג ומכונת המצבים של המבדוק (sail → gate → pump → work → fill → open → back) ---- */
 const PH_HE={sail:'איש המספנה משיט את הסירה אל המבדוק',gate:'השער נסגר',pump:'שואבים את המים מהמבדוק',work:'העבודה על הסירה',fill:'ממלאים את המבדוק במים',open:'השער נפתח',back:'הסירה חוזרת בשיט למקום שלה'};

 function order(id,cat,val,o){live();o=o||{};const b=byId(id),st=P();if(!b)return false;const m=b.model,u=b.rec.up;
  if(st.job)return toast('המבדוק תפוס — '+(byId(st.job.boat)||{}).name+' בעבודה'),false;if(F.S.aboard===id)return toast('קודם קושרים את הסירה ויורדים ממנה'),false;if(b.mode!=='moored')return toast('"'+b.name+'" צריכה להיות קשורה במקום שלה'),false;
  let price;if(cat==='paint'){val=val||{};price=upPrice(m,'paint',1)}else{val=+val;if(!UP[cat]||val!==(u[cat]||0)+1||val>upMax(m,cat))return toast('השדרוג הזה לא זמין לסירה הזו'),false;price=upPrice(m,cat,val)}
  if(!o.free){if(PlayerProfile.money<price)return toast('אין מספיק כסף — '+money(price)),false;PlayerProfile.money-=price;try{recordTransaction('boat-upgrade',-price,{boat:id,cat})}catch(e){}}
  const wt=whatOf(b,cat,val);st.job={boat:id,cat,val,price,phase:'sail',t:0,w:1,sec:UP[cat].sec*(o.fast===true?.25:o.fast||1),applied:0,at:Date.now(),what:wt.line,demo:o.demo?1:0};b.mode='yard';b.legs=rYard(b);b.onArrive=docked;
  msg('pl-shipyard','קיבלנו את "'+b.name+'" — '+jobTxt(st.job)+'. איש המספנה משיט אותה עכשיו אל המבדוק היבש; אפשר לבוא לראות את העבודה.');try{SaveManager.log('boatshop','order',{boat:id,cat})}catch(e){}save('yard-order');return true}
 function docked(b){const J=P().job;b.mode='dock';b.u=0;b.x=DKX;b.y=dockY(b);b.h=-Math.PI/2;b.legs=[];if(J){J.phase='gate';J.t=0}}

 function apply(b,J){const u=b.rec.up;if(J.cat==='paint'){const v=J.val||{};if(v.hull)b.rec.lv[0]=v.hull;if(v.stripe)b.rec.lv[1]=v.stripe;if(v.design!=null)u.design=v.design;u.anti=1}else u[J.cat]=J.val;refresh(b);J.applied=1}
 function yardStep(dt){const st=P(),J=st.job;if(!J)return;const b=byId(J.boat);if(!b){st.job=null;return}
  if(J.phase==='sail'||J.phase==='back')return;J.t+=dt;
  if(J.phase==='gate'){if(J.t>=3){J.phase='pump';J.t=0}}
  else if(J.phase==='pump'){J.w=cl(1-J.t/9,0,1);if(J.t>=9){J.phase='work';J.t=0}}
  else if(J.phase==='work'){J.w=0;if(!J.applied&&J.t>=J.sec*.7)apply(b,J);if(J.t>=J.sec){J.phase='fill';J.t=0}}
  else if(J.phase==='fill'){J.w=cl(J.t/9,0,1);if(J.t>=9){J.phase='open';J.t=0}}
  else if(J.phase==='open'){J.w=1;if(J.t>=3){J.phase='back';J.t=0;b.mode='yard';b.legs=rHome(b);b.onArrive=backHome}}}
 const gateK=J=>!J?0:J.phase==='gate'?cl(J.t/3,0,1):J.phase==='open'?1-cl(J.t/3,0,1):(J.phase==='sail'||J.phase==='back')?0:1;   /* 0 — פתוח, 1 — סגור */

 /* ---- הצייר של הסירות של השחקן: במקום — תמונה שמורה עם נדנוד וחבלי קשירה; בשיט — חי; במבדוק — מצוירת עם המבדוק (dockDraw) ---- */
 function paintBoat(c,b,x,y,h,t,o){if(!b.owned)return BOAT34.fish3(c,b,x,y,h,t,o);o=o||{};const sp=specOf(b);
  if(o.thumb)return BOAT34.paint(c,sp,x,y,h,t,{u:0,night:0,thumb:true,lod:2,noRefl:true,wave:.3});
  if(b.mode==='dock'){if(Camera.zoom>.3)return null;const J=P().job,q=J?dockLift(b,J):{lf:0,dry:false};return BOAT34.paint(c,sp,x,y,h,t,{u:0,night:o.night,lift:q.lf,dry:q.dry,noShadow:true,noRefl:true,wave:0,ph:0})}
  if(b.mode==='moored'&&!(o.people&&o.people.length)){const z=Camera.zoom*(window.devicePixelRatio||1),bob=Math.sin(t*1.5+b.ph)*.5;BOAT34.still(c,'MY|'+b.id+'|'+sp.upKey+'|'+sp.lvKey,sp,x,y,h,t,{moored:1,night:o.night},0,bob);
   if(z>.8){const s=slotOf(b.be.slot),by=y-b.L*.42-b.fb*KZ+bob,sy=y+b.L*.44-b.fb*KZ+bob;c.save();c.strokeStyle='rgba(236,228,206,.8)';c.lineWidth=.5;c.beginPath();
    for(const sd of[-1,1]){c.moveTo(x+sd*b.B*.2,by);c.quadraticCurveTo(x+sd*b.B*.4,(by+QY)/2+1.5,x+sd*Math.min(s.w*.46,b.B*.7),QY)}
    c.moveTo(x-b.B*.42,sy);c.quadraticCurveTo(x-b.B*.5-2,sy+2,s.x,Math.min(s.fin[3]-2,sy));c.stroke();c.restore()}return null}
  return BOAT34.paint(c,sp,x,y,h,t,{u:Math.abs(o.u||0),trail:o.trail,wave:o.wave,night:o.night,under:o.under,fishing:o.fishing,people:o.people})}
 try{F.setPainter(paintBoat)}catch(e){er('painter',e)}

 return{G,SL,DECKS,WH,QY,LY,DKX,CALM,calm,nearMouth,hDock,statsOf,visTxt,whatOf,FGEAR,TYPES,MODELS,MOD,HULLS,STRIPES,DESIGNS,UP,CLS_HE,PH_HE,OWN,ERR,er,P,byId,slotOf,freeSlot,dockY,specOf,refresh,mk,sync,live,buy,sell,sellValue,rename,refuel,fuelCost,order,upPrice,upMax,jobTxt,gateK,dockLift,rOut,rHome,rYard,rAway,keep,msg,paintBoat,yardStep,arrived}})();

 /* ---- המבדוק היבש: הקירות, הרצפה והאדנים, המים שיורדים, הסירה (BOAT34 — lift / dry), התמוכות, והשער ---- */
 function dockDraw(c,now,N){const [x0,y0,x1,y1]=G.dock,W=x1-x0,J=B.P().job,b=J&&B.byId(J.boat),inD=!!(b&&b.mode==='dock'),w=inD?J.w:1,dep=G.dockD*KZ,t=now/1000,gk=B.gateK(J),nv=nightV();
  if(inD&&w<1){c.save();c.beginPath();c.rect(x0,y0,W,y1-y0);c.clip();const drop=dep*(1-w);
   c.fillStyle=N?'#4a4d4d':'#8f8d84';c.fillRect(x0,y0+dep,W,y1-y0-dep);c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.14)';c.fillRect(x0+W/2-2,y0+dep,4,y1-y0-dep);
   for(let y=y0+dep+16;y<y1-14;y+=20){c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.25)';c.fillRect(x0+W/2-6,y+5,14,3);c.fillStyle='#5a4a34';c.fillRect(x0+W/2-7,y,14,5);c.fillStyle='#7a6648';c.fillRect(x0+W/2-7,y-2,14,2.4)}
   {const g=c.createLinearGradient(0,y0,0,y0+dep);g.addColorStop(0,N?'#6a6c6a':'#b3afa4');g.addColorStop(1,N?'#474949':'#7d7b73');c.fillStyle=g;c.fillRect(x0,y0,W,dep);c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.16)';for(let k=1;k<3;k++)c.fillRect(x0,y0+dep*k/3,W,1);
    c.fillStyle='rgba(20,40,50,.22)';c.fillRect(x0,y0+Math.max(0,drop-3),W,Math.min(drop,3)+.5);c.fillStyle='#e0b020';for(let k=0;k<5;k++)c.fillRect(x0+6+k*(W-12)/4-1,y0+2,2,dep-3)}
   c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.2)';c.fillRect(x0,y0,3,y1-y0);c.fillRect(x1-2,y0,2,y1-y0);
   if(w>.02){const wy=y0+drop;c.fillStyle='rgba(40,120,172,'+(.5+.42*w).toFixed(2)+')';c.fillRect(x0,wy,W,y1-wy);c.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.35)';c.lineWidth=.8;c.beginPath();for(let k=0;k<5;k++){const yy=wy+6+k*((y1-wy)/5)+Math.sin(t*1.3+k)*1.5;c.moveTo(x0+8+(k*17)%30,yy);c.lineTo(x0+30+(k*23)%40,yy+1)}c.stroke();
    c.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.5)';c.fillRect(x0,wy,W,1.2);if(J.phase==='pump'||J.phase==='fill'){for(let k=0;k<6;k++){const u=(t*1.4+k*.17)%1;c.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,'+(.7*(1-u)).toFixed(2)+')';c.beginPath();c.arc(x1-7+Math.sin(k*2)*3,y1-16-u*10*(J.phase==='fill'?-1:1),1.2+u*2,0,TAU);c.fill()}}}
   c.restore()}
  if(inD){const q=B.dockLift(b,J);try{BOAT34.paint(c,B.specOf(b),b.x,b.y,b.h,t,{u:0,night:nv,lift:q.lf,dry:q.dry,noShadow:true,noRefl:true,wave:q.dry?0:.08,ph:0})}catch(e){er('dockBoat',e)}
   if(q.dry){c.strokeStyle=N?'#6a5238':'#8a6a48';c.lineWidth=1.5;c.lineCap='round';c.beginPath();for(const f of[-.28,.02,.3])for(const s of[-1,1]){const yy=b.y+f*b.L;c.moveTo(s<0?x0+1:x1-1,yy-q.lf*KZ*.2+4);c.lineTo(b.x+s*b.B*.43,yy-(q.lf+b.fb*.45)*KZ)}c.stroke()}}
  /* השער: קופסת פלדה שמחליקה מערבה אל מתחת למשטח כשהוא נפתח */
  {const gx=x0-(W+2)*(1-gk),gy=y1-9;c.save();c.beginPath();c.rect(x0-1,gy-8,W+2,26);c.clip();c.fillStyle=N?'#27333c':'#3f5463';c.fillRect(gx,gy,W,9);c.fillStyle=N?'#1b242b':'#2c3c48';c.fillRect(gx,gy+9,W,6);c.fillStyle='#e0b020';for(let k=0;k<6;k++)c.fillRect(gx+4+k*(W-8)/5-2,gy+9,4,6);c.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.22)';c.fillRect(gx,gy,W,1.2);c.restore()}}

 /* ---- מנוף הזרוע: עמוד, זרוע מסתובבת, כבל ואונקל; בזמן העבודה מעביר את החלק מהמשטח אל הסירה שבמבדוק ---- */
 const A_PARK=-2.5;
 function craneState(now){const J=B.P().job,b=J&&B.byId(J.boat),t=now/1000,cx=G.crane[0],cy=G.crane[1];let a=A_PARK+Math.sin(t*.25)*.05,rr=44,zh=5.4+Math.sin(t*.9)*.15,load=null;
  if(J&&J.phase==='work'&&b&&b.mode==='dock'&&!J.applied){const u=(J.t%14)/14,ty=cl(b.y-b.L*.15,cy-40,cy+40),aD=Math.atan2(ty-cy,B.DKX-cx),rD=cl(Math.hypot(B.DKX-cx,ty-cy),24,G.reach),aP=Math.atan2(2680-cy,7880-cx),rP=Math.hypot(7880-cx,2680-cy);
   if(u<.16){a=aP;rr=rP;zh=lerp(5.4,.9,ease(u/.16))}else if(u<.3){a=aP;rr=rP;zh=lerp(.9,5.4,ease((u-.16)/.14));load=J.cat}
   else if(u<.56){const e=ease((u-.3)/.26);a=lerp(aP,aD,e);rr=lerp(rP,rD,e);zh=5.4;load=J.cat}
   else if(u<.72){a=aD;rr=rD;zh=lerp(5.4,1.4,ease((u-.56)/.16));load=J.cat}else if(u<.82){a=aD;rr=rD;zh=lerp(1.4,5.4,ease((u-.72)/.1))}
   else{const e=ease((u-.82)/.18);a=lerp(aD,aP,e);rr=lerp(rD,rP,e);zh=5.4}}
  return{a,rr,zh,load,col:J&&J.cat==='paint'&&J.val&&J.val.hull||'#e0731d'}}
 function craneDraw(c,now,N){const cx=G.crane[0],cy=G.crane[1],H=G.craneH*KZ,S=craneState(now),ca=Math.cos(S.a),sa=Math.sin(S.a),top=[cx,cy-H],end=[cx+ca*G.reach,cy+sa*G.reach-H],hk=[cx+ca*S.rr,cy+sa*S.rr],Y=N?'#a87a18':'#e0a020',Yd=N?'#7a5810':'#b07a10';
  c.save();c.lineCap='round';c.strokeStyle='rgba(8,16,24,.18)';c.lineWidth=3;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(cx+G.craneH*2.7,cy+G.craneH*3.6);c.lineTo(cx+ca*G.reach+G.craneH*2.7,cy+sa*G.reach+G.craneH*3.6);c.stroke();
  c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.25)';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(cx+2,cy+1.5,7,3.6,0,0,TAU);c.fill();c.fillStyle=N?'#555':'#7d868c';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(cx,cy,6,3,0,0,TAU);c.fill();
  c.fillStyle=Yd;c.fillRect(cx-2.6,cy-H,5.2,H);c.fillStyle=Y;c.fillRect(cx-2.6,cy-H,2.2,H);c.fillStyle='#1d2124';for(let k=1;k<5;k++)c.fillRect(cx-2.6,cy-H*k/5,5.2,1);
  c.strokeStyle=Yd;c.lineWidth=3.2;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(cx-ca*14,cy-sa*14-H);c.lineTo(end[0],end[1]);c.stroke();c.strokeStyle=Y;c.lineWidth=1.4;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(cx-ca*14,cy-sa*14-H-1);c.lineTo(end[0],end[1]-1);c.stroke();
  c.strokeStyle='#3a4046';c.lineWidth=.7;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(cx,cy-H-9);c.lineTo(end[0]-ca*6,end[1]);c.moveTo(cx,cy-H-9);c.lineTo(cx-ca*14,cy-sa*14-H);c.moveTo(cx,cy-H);c.lineTo(cx,cy-H-9);c.stroke();
  c.fillStyle='#4a5056';c.fillRect(cx-ca*14-3,cy-sa*14-H-2.5,6,5);c.fillStyle=N?'#ffd36a':'#2a2f35';c.fillRect(cx-2,cy-H-5,4,4);
  const hy=hk[1]-S.zh*KZ;c.strokeStyle='#1d2124';c.lineWidth=.6;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(hk[0],hk[1]-H);c.lineTo(hk[0],hy);c.stroke();c.fillStyle='#f2c230';c.fillRect(hk[0]-1.5,hy-1,3,2.4);
  if(S.load){const x=hk[0],y=hy+2;c.strokeStyle='#1d2124';c.lineWidth=.5;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x,y-1);c.lineTo(x-4,y+3);c.moveTo(x,y-1);c.lineTo(x+4,y+3);c.stroke();
   if(S.load==='engine'){c.fillStyle='#2a2f35';c.fillRect(x-4,y+3,8,10);c.fillStyle='#c43b2f';c.fillRect(x-4,y+6,8,1.5);c.fillStyle='#8c949a';c.fillRect(x-1,y+13,2,5)}
   else if(S.load==='tank'){c.fillStyle='#b9c0c5';c.fillRect(x-6,y+3,12,6);c.fillStyle='#d8dde0';c.fillRect(x-6,y+2,12,2);c.fillStyle='#c43b2f';c.fillRect(x-1,y+1,2,1.4)}
   else if(S.load==='fishing'){c.strokeStyle='#2a2d31';c.lineWidth=.8;c.beginPath();for(let k=-1;k<=1;k++){c.moveTo(x-8,y+4+k);c.lineTo(x+10,y+4+k*.4)}c.stroke();c.fillStyle='#e8ecee';c.fillRect(x-7,y+5,5,4)}
   else if(S.load==='elec'){c.fillStyle='#f4f6f8';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(x,y+6,5,3.2,0,0,TAU);c.fill();c.fillStyle='#c9ced2';c.fillRect(x-1,y+8,2,4)}
   else{c.fillStyle='#8a6a48';c.fillRect(x-7,y+10,14,2);for(let k=0;k<3;k++){c.fillStyle=k===1?'#f4f4f0':S.col;c.fillRect(x-6+k*4.4,y+3,3.6,7)}}}
  c.restore()}

 /* ---- החי: המבדוק, האנשים בעבודה, הניצוצות והריסוס, המים ליד הכלונסאות, סימוני F ---- */
 function liveL(c,now,N){const t=now/1000;try{if(viewS())shopLive(c,now,N);if(!viewM()){marks(c,now);return}
   const vY=viewY(),J=B.P().job,b=J&&B.byId(J.boat),work=J&&J.phase==='work'&&b&&b.mode==='dock';if(vY)dockDraw(c,now,N);
   /* איש המעגן הולך לאורך הרציף ומגלגל חבל; השומר בשער */

 function sea(g,W,H,t){const gr=g.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);gr.addColorStop(0,'#3a8fc2');gr.addColorStop(1,'#1c6593');g.fillStyle=gr;g.fillRect(0,0,W,H);g.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.13)';g.lineWidth=1.2;for(let y=14;y<H;y+=18){g.beginPath();for(let x=0;x<=W;x+=14)g.lineTo(x,y+Math.sin(x*.045+y+t*1.2)*2);g.stroke()}}
 function drawSpec(cv,sp,hd,t,zr){const g=cv.getContext('2d'),W=cv.width,H=cv.height,T=BOAT34.T[sp.type];g.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);sea(g,W,H,t);const sc=Math.min(W*.7,H*1.05)/(sp.L*.82+sp.B*.5+T.real[2]*(sp.L/(T.real[0]*10))*KZ*.5)*(zr||1);
  g.save();g.translate(W/2,H*.6);g.scale(sc,sc);try{BOAT34.paint(g,sp,0,0,hd,t,{night:0,u:0,lod:2,scaleHint:sc,wave:.25,thumb:false,noRefl:false,ph:0})}catch(e){er('cv',e)}g.restore()}
 function paintCv(){try{const body=$('phoneBody');if(!body||!State.phoneOpen||!POIS[State.interactionId])return;const t=performance.now()/1000;

 /* the walkers' graph of the game has pieces that touch nothing (a dead-end street's pavements, the corners of some junctions): each piece is joined
    to the big network by a short straight step on the pavement — never across a road (clLineClear) — in CITY_LIVE's own copy; PED_GRAPH is not changed */
 const comp=()=>{const C=new Map();let k=0;const S={};for(const id of N.keys()){if(C.has(id))continue;k++;const st=[id];C.set(id,k);S[k]=1;while(st.length){const u=st.pop();for(const [v] of (A.get(u)||[]))if(!C.has(v)){C.set(v,k);S[k]++;st.push(v)}}}let big=1;for(const q in S)if(S[q]>S[big])big=+q;return{C,S,big}};
 let K=comp();const bridges=[];for(let pass=0;pass<3;pass++){let added=0;const mains=[...N.values()].filter(n=>K.C.get(n.id)===K.big);
  for(const n of [...N.values()]){if(K.C.get(n.id)===K.big)continue;let best=null,bd=250,via=null;
   bd=250;for(const m of mains){const d=Math.hypot(m.x-n.x,m.y-n.y);if(d>=175)continue;
    if(d<bd&&clLineClear(n.x,n.y,m.x,m.y)){bd=d;best=m;via=null;continue}
    /* round the corner of a junction: two straight steps on the pavement, through the corner point (never across the road) */
    for(const c of [[n.x,m.y],[m.x,n.y]]){const dd=Math.abs(c[0]-n.x)+Math.abs(c[1]-n.y)+Math.abs(c[0]-m.x)+Math.abs(c[1]-m.y);if(dd<bd&&!clOnRoad(c[0],c[1])&&clLineClear(n.x,n.y,c[0],c[1])&&clLineClear(c[0],c[1],m.x,m.y)){bd=dd;best=m;via=c}}}
   if(best){if(via){const cid='CL-CORNER-'+bridges.length;N.set(cid,{id:cid,x:via[0],y:via[1]});const d1=Math.hypot(via[0]-n.x,via[1]-n.y),d2=Math.hypot(via[0]-best.x,via[1]-best.y);add(n.id,cid,d1,null);add(cid,best.id,d2,null);E.push([n.id,cid,null],[cid,best.id,null])}
    else{add(n.id,best.id,Math.hypot(best.x-n.x,best.y-n.y),null);E.push([n.id,best.id,null])}bridges.push([n.id,best.id,via]);added++}}
  if(!added)break;K=comp()}
 const segs=[];for(const [a0,b0,cw] of E){if(cw)continue;if(K.C.get(a0)!==K.big)continue;const a=N.get(a0),b=N.get(b0);if(Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y)>.5)segs.push({a:a0,b:b0,ax:a.x,ay:a.y,bx:b.x,by:b.y})}
 /* the crossings at the two ends of the terminal's roads (LC-E3W, LC-E3N): a walker there asks the light for a walk phase, and a bus of the line
    waits for it on the terminal's road (D‑598 counts every such stop) — the city's walkers cross elsewhere */
 const J=new Set();for(const id of ['LC-E3W','LC-E3N']){const e=byEdge[id];if(e){J.add(e.a);J.add(e.b)}}const avoid=new Set();
 for(const c of [...CROSSWALKS,...(typeof ZEBRA_XW!=='undefined'?ZEBRA_XW:[])]){const n=c.signalNode||c.node;if(J.has(n)||c.roadId==='LC-E3W'||c.roadId==='LC-E3N')avoid.add(c.id)}
 return CL.G={N,A,segs,bridges:bridges.length,pieces:Object.keys(K.S).length,main:K.S[K.big],avoid}}
/* the nearest point of the walkers' graph that a person can reach from (x,y) in a straight line without stepping on a road */
function clAttach(x,y,maxD){const G=clGraph();let best=null;const L=[];
 for(const s of G.segs){const dx=s.bx-s.ax,dy=s.by-s.ay,l2=dx*dx+dy*dy,u=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((x-s.ax)*dx+(y-s.ay)*dy)/l2)),px=s.ax+dx*u,py=s.ay+dy*u,d=Math.hypot(x-px,y-py);if(d<=(maxD||260))L.push({d,x:px,y:py,a:s.a,b:s.b})}
 L.sort((p,q)=>p.d-q.d);for(const q of L.slice(0,10)){if(clLineClear(x,y,q.x,q.y)){best=q;break}}return best}
/* Dijkstra from one attachment to another (a binary heap) — the points of the way, each with the crossing it ends (cw) */
function clRoute(s,t,avoid){if(!s||!t)return null;const G=clGraph(),N=G.N,A=G.A;
 if((s.a===t.a&&s.b===t.b)||(s.a===t.b&&s.b===t.a))return[{x:t.x,y:t.y}];
 const dist=new Map(),prev=new Map(),H=[];const push=(d,id)=>{H.push([d,id]);let i=H.length-1;while(i>0){const j=(i-1)>>1;if(H[j][0]<=H[i][0])break;[H[i],H[j]]=[H[j],H[i]];i=j}};
 const pop=()=>{const top=H[0],last=H.pop();if(H.length){H[0]=last;let i=0;for(;;){const l=2*i+1,r=l+1;let m=i;if(l<H.length&&H[l][0]<H[m][0])m=l;if(r<H.length&&H[r][0]<H[m][0])m=r;if(m===i)break;[H[i],H[m]]=[H[m],H[i]];i=m}}return top};
 for(const id of [s.a,s.b]){const n=N.get(id);const d=Math.hypot(n.x-s.x,n.y-s.y);if(d<(dist.get(id)??Infinity)){dist.set(id,d);prev.set(id,null);push(d,id)}}
 const goal=new Set([t.a,t.b]),done=new Set();let found=0;
 while(H.length){const [d,id]=pop();if(done.has(id))continue;done.add(id);if(goal.has(id)){found++;if(found>=2)break}if(d>24000)break;
  for(const [to,w,cw] of (A.get(id)||[])){if(cw&&((avoid&&avoid.has(cw))||G.avoid.has(cw)))continue;const nd=d+w+(cw?(ZEBRA_BY_ID[cw]?120:40):0);if(nd<(dist.get(to)??Infinity)){dist.set(to,nd);prev.set(to,[id,cw]);push(nd,to)}}}
 let end=null,bd=Infinity;for(const id of [t.a,t.b]){if(!dist.has(id))continue;const n=N.get(id),d=dist.get(id)+Math.hypot(n.x-t.x,n.y-t.y);if(d<bd){bd=d;end=id}}
 if(end==null)return null;const ids=[];let k=end,cws=[];while(k!=null){ids.unshift(k);const pv=prev.get(k);if(!pv){cws.unshift(null);break}cws.unshift(pv[1]);k=pv[0]}
 const out=[];for(let i=0;i<ids.length;i++){const n=N.get(ids[i]);const q={x:n.x,y:n.y};if(i>0&&cws[i]){q.cw=cws[i];q.a=ids[i-1];q.b=ids[i]}out.push(q)}
 out.push({x:t.x,y:t.y});return out}
function clPathLen(P,x,y){let d=0,px=x,py=y;for(const q of P){d+=Math.hypot(q.x-px,q.y-py);px=q.x;py=q.y}return d}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- the places: the doors, the stops ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function clDoorsInit(){if(CL.doors.length)return;
 for(const r of [...CL_DOORS,...CL_GATES]){const [id,k,x,y,ax,ay,z]=r;const att=clAttach(ax,ay,40)||clAttach(x,y,220);if(!att){CL.stats.doorNoAttach=(CL.stats.doorNoAttach||0)+1;continue}
  const D={id,k,x,y,ax,ay,z,att,n:0};CL.doors.push(D);CL.dById[id]=D}
 CL.homes=CL.doors.filter(d=>d.k==='home');CL.places=CL.doors.filter(d=>d.k==='place');CL.gates=CL.doors.filter(d=>d.k==='gate')}
function clStopPf(S){return{x:S.C.x+S.n.x*40,y:S.C.y+S.n.y*40}}
function clStopsInit(){if(CL.stopsInit)return;CL.stopsInit=true;CL.stopAtt={};for(const id in LN.stops){const S=LN.stops[id],p=clStopPf(S),a=clAttach(p.x,p.y,120);if(a)CL.stopAtt[id]={x:p.x,y:p.y,att:a}}}
/* the line-3 stops a person can use between two doors: the boarding stop near the origin, the alighting stop near the destination, later on the same direction */
function clBusPlan(o,d){if(!LN.on||!LN.seeded||!CL.stopAtt)return null;let best=null;
 for(const L of LN_LINES)for(const dir of ['F','B']){const Q=L[dir];for(let i=0;i<Q.length-1;i++){const A=CL.stopAtt[Q[i]];if(!A)continue;const da=Math.hypot(A.x-o.x,A.y-o.y);if(da>1600)continue;
   for(let j=i+1;j<Q.length;j++){const B=CL.stopAtt[Q[j]];if(!B)continue;const db=Math.hypot(B.x-d.x,B.y-d.y);if(db>1300||da+db>Math.hypot(o.x-d.x,o.y-d.y)*.85)continue;const c=da+db+(j-i)*40;if(!best||c<best.c)best={c,from:Q[i],to:Q[j],dir,L}}}}
 return best}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- the people ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function clMk(home,id){const n=++CL.serial,pid=id||('CL-P-'+n),h=stableHash(pid);const p={id:pid,cl:true,asset:CL_ASSETS[h%CL_ASSETS.length],x:home?home.x:0,y:home?home.y:0,dir:2,pose:'idle',speed:28+(h>>>4)%9,wait:false,inCrosswalk:null,nodeId:null,targetId:null,ghost:0,blockT:0,hop:0,
  st:'in',at:home,home,car:null,trip:null,path:null,pi:0,nextT:0,shown:false};CL.P.push(p);CL.byId.set(pid,p);return p}
function clShow(p,x,y){p.x=x;p.y=y;if(!p.shown){NPC_PEDESTRIANS.push(p);p.shown=true}}
function clHide(p){if(p.shown){const i=NPC_PEDESTRIANS.indexOf(p);if(i>=0)NPC_PEDESTRIANS.splice(i,1);p.shown=false}p.inCrosswalk=null;p.wait=false;p.nodeId=null;p.targetId=null}
const CL_OUT=new Set(['walk','go','taxiwait','alight','boarding','car','taxi','bus','gatewait']);   /* on the way (the waiting at a stop are drawn by the stop) */
function clOut(){let n=0;for(const p of CL.P)if(CL_OUT.has(p.st))n++;return n}
/* out of a door: the person appears at the door and walks */
function clDoorOut(p,door){p.at=null;clShow(p,door.x,door.y);p.dir=npcDir(door.ax-door.x,door.ay-door.y,2);CL.stats.doorOut++;clEv('דלת-יציאה',p,door.x,door.y)}
function clDoorIn(p,door){clHide(p);p.st='in';p.at=door;p.trip=null;p.path=null;p.x=door.x;p.y=door.y;CL.stats.doorIn++;clEv('דלת-כניסה',p,door.x,door.y);
 p.nextT=CL.t+(door===p.home?90+clR()*260:door===p.work?700+clR()*500:50+clR()*200)}
/* walk from where the person stands to a point (with its attachment) */
/* the car park A3-P: a person walks along the aisle (the east side, 1 m from the cars) between his car and the mouth of the car park */
const CL_A3P_WALK={x0:4,x1:208,y0:1700,y1:2478,ax:132,mouth:{x:132,y:2490}};
function clInLot(x,y){const L=CL_A3P_WALK;return x>=L.x0&&x<=L.x1&&y>=L.y0&&y<=L.y1}
function clYard(x,y){if(clInLot(x,y))return CL_A3P_WALK;for(const k in CL.alleys){const A=CL.alleys[k];if(A.yard&&A.yard.inside(x,y))return A.yard}return null}
function clWalkTo(p,to,toAtt,after,avoid){const L=CL_A3P_WALK,pre=[],post=[];let sx=p.x,sy=p.y;
 /* p730: the yards — the aisle of A3-P and the alleys of B3 (from the drive along the alley to its mouth on the pavement of LC-B, and back) */
 const Y1=clYard(p.x,p.y),Y2=to?clYard(to.x,to.y):null;
 if(Y1&&Y1.out){if(Y2===Y1){p.path=Y1.within(p,to);p.pi=0;p.st='walk';p.after=after;p.goal=null;return true}pre.push(...Y1.out(p));sx=Y1.mouth.x;sy=Y1.mouth.y}
 else if(Y1){pre.push({x:L.ax,y:p.y},{x:L.mouth.x,y:L.mouth.y});sx=L.mouth.x;sy=L.mouth.y}
 if(Y2&&Y2.in){post.push(...Y2.in(to));toAtt=Y2.att||(Y2.att=clAttach(Y2.mouth.x,Y2.mouth.y,120))}
 else if(Y2){post.push({x:L.mouth.x,y:L.mouth.y},{x:L.ax,y:to.y});toAtt=CL.mouthAtt||(CL.mouthAtt=clAttach(L.mouth.x,L.mouth.y,260))}
 if(Y1&&Y2&&Y1===Y2&&!Y1.out){p.path=[...pre.slice(0,1),{x:L.ax,y:to.y},{x:to.x,y:to.y}];p.pi=0;p.st='walk';p.after=after;p.goal=null;return true}
 const from=clAttach(sx,sy,260);let R=from&&toAtt?clRoute(from,toAtt,avoid):null;if(!R){CL.stats.noRoute++;return false}p.goal={to,toAtt,after};
 if(pre.length||post.length){const P=[...pre,{x:from.x,y:from.y},...R,...post];if(to)P.push({x:to.x,y:to.y});p.path=P;p.pi=0;p.st='walk';p.after=after;return true}
 const P=[{x:from.x,y:from.y},...R];if(to)P.push({x:to.x,y:to.y});p.path=P;p.pi=0;p.st='walk';p.after=after;return true}
function clStepWalker(p,dt){const P=p.path;if(!P)return true;let m=0;
 const sp=(p.inCrosswalk?52:p.speed*(typeof wxHurry==='function'?wxHurry(p):1));m=sp*dt;
 while(p.pi<P.length){const q=P[p.pi];
  if(q.cw&&p.inCrosswalk!==q.cw){if(!pedestrianWalkAllowed(q.cw)){p.wait=true;p.pose='idle';p.nodeId=q.a;p.targetId=q.b;p.waitT=(p.waitT||0)+dt;if(p.waitT>(CL.stats.maxCwWait||0))CL.stats.maxCwWait=+p.waitT.toFixed(1);
   if(p.waitT>22&&p.goal&&!(p.avoid&&p.avoid.has(q.cw))){const av=new Set(p.avoid||[]);av.add(q.cw);const G=p.goal;p.avoid=av;if(clWalkTo(p,G.to,G.toAtt,G.after,av)){p.waitT=0;p.wait=false;p.nodeId=null;p.targetId=null;CL.stats.reroute2=(CL.stats.reroute2||0)+1;return false}}
   return false}p.inCrosswalk=q.cw;p.nodeId=q.a;p.targetId=q.b;p.waitT=0}
  const dx=q.x-p.x,dy=q.y-p.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);p.wait=false;
  if(d>m){p.x+=dx/d*m;p.y+=dy/d*m;p.dir=npcDir(dx,dy,p.dir);p.pose=p.inCrosswalk?'running':'walking';return false}
  p.x=q.x;p.y=q.y;m-=d;p.pi++;if(d>.01)p.dir=npcDir(dx,dy,p.dir);if(q.cw){p.inCrosswalk=null;p.nodeId=null;p.targetId=null}}
 p.pose='idle';p.avoid=null;p.goal=null;return true}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- the trips ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* a trip from where the person is (inside a door) to a door: the way and the means are decided here */
function clHouseCar(p,from,to){for(const c of CL.cars)if(c.home&&c.home===p.home&&clCarUsable(c,from,to))return c;return null}
function clTrip(p,to,why){const from=p.at;if(!from||!to||from===to)return false;const d=Math.hypot(to.x-from.x,to.y-from.y);
 let mode='walk',bp=null,pk=null;const car=clHouseCar(p,from,to);
 if(car)mode='car';
 else if(d>1250){bp=clBusPlan(from,to);if(bp&&clR()<.85)mode='bus';else if(d>1500&&clTaxiFree()&&(pk=clTaxiCurb(from))&&clTaxiCurb(to)&&(d>2600||clR()<.5))mode='taxi'}
 if(mode==='walk'&&d>3400){p.nextT=CL.t+60+clR()*90;return false}   /* too far on foot and no other way now — later */
 p.trip={mode,from,to,why:why||'',t0:CL.t};p.st='go';CL.stats.trips++;CL.stats[mode]++;
 if(mode==='car')return clCarTripStart(p,car,from,to);
 clDoorOut(p,from);
 if(mode==='bus'){p.trip.bus=bp;const A=CL.stopAtt[bp.from];if(clWalkTo(p,A,A.att,'stop'))return true;clBackIn(p,from);return false}
 if(mode==='taxi'){p.trip.pick=pk;if(clWalkTo(p,pk,pk.att,'taxi-wait'))return true;clBackIn(p,from);return false}
 if(clWalkTo(p,to,to.att,to.k==='gate'?'gate':'door'))return true;clBackIn(p,from);return false}
function clBackIn(p,door){CL.stats.walkFail++;if(p.shown){clDoorIn(p,door)}else{p.st='in';p.at=door;p.trip=null}p.nextT=CL.t+60+clR()*120;return false}
/* the end of a walk */
function clArrive(p){const a=p.after,T=p.trip;p.path=null;
 if(a==='door'){clDoorIn(p,T?T.to:p.home);return}
 if(a==='gate'){clGateIn(p);return}
 if(a==='gate-open'){if(CL.match&&(CL.match.ph==='leave'||CL.match.ph==='done'))clGateLate(p);else clGateEnter(p);return}
 if(a==='stop'){clStopJoin(p);return}
 if(a==='taxi-wait'){p.st='taxiwait';p.pose='idle';p.dir=npcDir(p.trip.pick.x-p.trip.pick.att.x,p.trip.pick.y-p.trip.pick.att.y,p.dir);const v=TRAFFIC_CARS.find(q=>q.clTaxi&&q.clTaxi.p===p);if(v){if(v.clTaxi.ph==='board')clTaxiKerb(p,v)}else clTaxiCall(p);return}
 if(a==='car-in'){clCarBoard(p);return}
 if(a==='gatewait'){p.st='gatewait';p.pose='idle';p.dir=0;return}
 if(a==='taxi-at'){p.st='taxiwait';p.atTaxi=true;p.pose='idle';return}
 if(a==='home'){clDoorIn(p,p.home);return}
 clDoorIn(p,p.home)}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- the bus (line 3 of LINES576) ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function clStopJoin(p){const sid=p.trip.bus.from;clHide(p);p.st='stop';p.stop=sid;(CL.stopQ[sid]||(CL.stopQ[sid]=[])).push(p);LN.q[sid].waiting++;CL.stats.stopJoin++;clEv('תחנה-הצטרפות',p,p.x,p.y)}
/* the boarders of a bus at stop S: the people of the queue whose stop is later on this bus's direction (LN decided how many; never more than wait for it) */
function clBayStart(B,S){const Q=CL.stopQ[S.id]||[];const L=lnLoop(B),later=L.slice(L.indexOf(S.id)+1);
 /* who gets off here: the people of this bus whose stop it is (or all of them on its last trip) */
 const on=CL.onBus[B.id]||(CL.onBus[B.id]=[]);const offP=B.retire?on.slice():on.filter(p=>p.trip&&p.trip.bus&&p.trip.bus.to===S.id);

 const want=B.on||0;const take=[];for(const p of Q){if(take.length>=want)break;if(p.trip&&p.trip.bus&&later.includes(p.trip.bus.to))take.push(p)}

 for(const p of take)B.pax.push(p.trip.bus.to);B.clOn=take}
var __clBayStart=lnBayStart;lnBayStart=function(B,S){__clBayStart(B,S);try{if(CL.on&&CL.seeded&&B.ph==='bay'&&!B.nodoor)clBayStart(B,S);else{B.clOn=[];B.clOff=[]}}catch(e){CL.err=CL.err||'bay '+String(e&&e.message||e)}};
var __clBayStep=lnBayStep;lnBayStep=function(B,dt){const n0=BUS_ALIGHTERS.length;__clBayStep(B,dt);if(!CL.on||!CL.seeded)return;try{
 for(const a of BUS_ALIGHTERS.slice(n0)){
  if(a.board){const p=(B.clOn||[]).shift();if(!p){a.clNew=true;continue}const Q=CL.stopQ[B.at]||[],k=Q.indexOf(p);if(k>=0)Q.splice(k,1);a.id=p.id;a.asset=p.asset;a.clp=p;p.st='boarding';p.boardBus=B.id;p.stop=null;
   /* a long queue: LN puts boarder k 6 px further along the platform each time (k 40 — 250 px away) and he would not reach the door in his 5 s;
      he steps out of the waiting group by the shelter instead (the group stands there), a few metres from the door */
   const S=LN.stops[B.at];if(S){const j=(B.onDone-1)%8;a.x=S.C.x+S.n.x*40-S.u.x*(10+j*6);a.y=S.C.y+S.n.y*40-S.u.y*(10+j*6)}clEv('תחנה-עולה',p,a.x,a.y);continue}
  const p=(B.clOff||[]).shift();if(p){a.id=p.id;a.asset=p.asset;a.clp=p;p.st='alight';CL.stats.busOut++;clEv('אוטובוס-ירידה',p,a.x,a.y)}else a.clNew=true}}catch(e){CL.err=CL.err||'baystep '+String(e&&e.message||e)}};
/* the terminal (E3): the people waiting there for line 3 board at the boarding bay — they get their own stops of the line */
var __clStep=lnStep;lnStep=function(v,dt){const B=v.ln;let w0=null,q=null;try{if(CL.on&&CL.seeded&&B&&B.ph==='tdwell'&&B.bt===0){q=busPassengerStop(BUS_TERMINAL_STOPS[B.L.line].id);w0=q.waiting}}catch(e){}
 __clStep(v,dt);if(w0==null)return;try{const n=w0-q.waiting;if(n>0){const nx=B.L[B.dir];B.pax.splice(B.pax.length-n,n);const on=CL.onBus[B.id]||(CL.onBus[B.id]=[]);
  for(let j=0;j<n;j++){let p=CL.termQ.shift();if(!p){p=clMk(null);p.st='bus';CL.stats.visitors++}const to=nx[stableHash(p.id+':T')%nx.length];p.trip={mode:'bus',bus:{from:'T',to,dir:B.dir,L:B.L},to:null,t0:CL.t};p.st='bus';B.pax.push(to);on.push(p);CL.stats.busIn++;clEv('אוטובוס-עלייה (מסוף)',p,v.x,v.y)}}}catch(e){CL.err=CL.err||'term '+String(e&&e.message||e)}};
/* the boarders who went in at the door are on the bus; the alighters who reached the pavement walk on to their door (they never fade out) */
function clBusPeople(){for(let i=BUS_ALIGHTERS.length-1;i>=0;i--){const a=BUS_ALIGHTERS[i];if(a.delay>0)continue;
  if(a.board){if(a.clp){a.clp.x=a.x;a.clp.y=a.y;a.ttl=Math.max(a.ttl,1.5)}continue}   /* he goes in at the door — never fades on the way */
  if((a.stage>=1&&a.targets&&a.targets.length>1)||a.ttl<1.4){BUS_ALIGHTERS.splice(i,1);let p=a.clp;
   if(!p){p=CL.byId.get(a.id)||clMk(null,a.id);p.asset=a.asset;CL.stats.visitors++;p.trip={mode:'bus',to:null,t0:CL.t}}
   clShow(p,a.x,a.y);p.dir=a.dir;let to=p.trip&&p.trip.to;if(!to){to=clNearPlace(a.x,a.y,p);p.trip=p.trip||{};p.trip.to=to;if(!p.home)p.home=to}
   if(!to||!clWalkTo(p,to,to.att,'door'))clStranded(p)}}}
function clBoardWatch(){for(const p of CL.P){if(p.st!=='boarding')continue;if(BUS_ALIGHTERS.some(q=>q.clp===p))continue;   /* still walking to the door */
  const B=LN.bus.find(b=>b.id===p.boardBus);p.st='bus';CL.stats.busIn++;
  if(B){(CL.onBus[B.id]||(CL.onBus[B.id]=[])).push(p);clEv('אוטובוס-עלייה',p,p.x,p.y)}else{CL.stats.boardLost=(CL.stats.boardLost||0)+1}}}
function clNearPlace(x,y,p){let best=null,bd=1e9;for(const d of CL.places){const q=Math.hypot(d.x-x,d.y-y);if(q<bd){bd=q;best=d}}return best}
/* a person with no way left: walks to the nearest door he can reach (never vanishes) */
function clStranded(p){CL.stats.stranded=(CL.stats.stranded||0)+1;let best=null,bd=1e9;for(const d of CL.doors){const q=Math.hypot(d.x-p.x,d.y-p.y);if(q<bd&&d.k!=='gate'){bd=q;best=d}}
 if(best&&clWalkTo(p,best,best.att,'door')){p.trip=p.trip||{};p.trip.to=best;if(!p.home)p.home=best;return}p.st='stuck';p.pose='idle'}

function clStallBusy(st){if(st.res)return true;for(const o of allParkedCars())if(Math.abs(o.x-st.x)<9&&Math.abs(o.y-st.y)<9)return true;return false}
function clLotFreeN(lot){const L=CL.lots[lot];return L?L.stalls.filter(s=>!clStallBusy(s)).length:0}
function clLotFree(lot){const L=CL.lots[lot];if(!L)return null;const free=L.stalls.filter(s=>!clStallBusy(s));if(!free.length)return null;if(lot==='C2M')free.sort((a,b)=>Math.abs(a.x-3000)-Math.abs(b.x-3000));else free.sort((a,b)=>b.y-a.y);return free[Math.floor(clR()*Math.min(free.length,6))]}
/* a villa drive: the street it opens to, the side, and the direction out (toward the open end of the street — LC-C3 to the north, LC-D3V to the south) */
function clDriveSpot(o){const pos=nearestRoadPosition(o.x,o.y);if(!pos||pos.d>140)return null;const e=pos.edge,A=byNode[e.a],B=byNode[e.b],L=Math.hypot(B.x-A.x,B.y-A.y),ux=(B.x-A.x)/L,uy=(B.y-A.y)/L;
 const open=e.id==='LC-C3'?-1:e.id==='LC-D3V'?-1:null;if(open==null)return null;   /* the edge's a end is the open one */
 const side=Math.sign(-(o.x-A.x)*uy+(o.y-A.y)*ux)||1;   /* + : the right of a→b */
 const deg=id=>EDGES.filter(q=>!q.future&&(q.a===id||q.b===id)).length,bend=deg(e.a)===2;   /* p730: the open end is a bend (two roads, no junction) */
 const outDir=open,J=clLanePt(e.id,outDir,o.x,o.y,52),ln=lane2(e.id,outDir,0),sJ=J.t*L;if(!bend&&ln&&sJ>Math.min(ln.stopS,ln.len)-44)return null;   /* too near the junction: the way out would end in it */
 const inDir=-open,A2=clLanePt(e.id,inDir,o.x,o.y,-46),ln2=lane2(e.id,inDir,0);if(!bend&&ln2&&A2.t*L<(ln2.boxFrom||0)+40)return null;   /* and the stop before it on the way in would stand in the junction */
 return{edge:e.id,u:pos.u,L,ux,uy,side,outDir,inDir,sx:pos.x,sy:pos.y}}
/* p730: the car park of the destination — the sports quarter and the stadium: A3-P; the mall: its car park (C2M) */
function clLotFor(to){if(!to)return null;if(to.z==='A4'||to.k==='gate')return'A3P';if(to.id==='C2-MALL'&&CL.lots.C2M)return'C2M';return null}
function clCarUsable(c,from,to){if(c.commute||c.ph!=='park'||c.v)return false;
 if(c.where==='home'&&from===c.home){const L=clLotFor(to);return !!L&&clLotFreeN(L)>0}
 if(c.where!=='home'&&to===c.home)return true;return false}
/* the driver (and the household with him) walk to the car */
function clCarTripStart(p,c,from,to){c.ph='boarding';c.party=[p];c.owner=p;c.trip={from,to,lotTo:c.where==='home'?(clLotFor(to)||'A3P'):'home'};
 if(c.trip.lotTo!=='home'){const st=clLotFree(c.trip.lotTo);if(!st){c.ph='park';c.party=[];c.trip=null;p.trip.mode='walk';CL.stats.car--;CL.stats.walk++;clDoorOut(p,from);if(clWalkTo(p,to,to.att,to.k==='gate'?'gate':'door'))return true;return clBackIn(p,from)}st.res=c.id;c.trip.stall=st}
 /* one or two of the household come along (in the car — they are counted in it) */
 const extra=Math.floor(clR()*3);
 for(const q of CL.P){if(c.party.length>=1+extra)break;if(q===p||q.st!=='in'||q.at!==from||q.home!==c.home)continue;q.trip={mode:'car',from,to,why:p.trip.why,t0:CL.t,ride:c.id};q.st='go';c.party.push(q)}
 for(const q of c.party.slice()){if(c.ph!=='boarding')break;q.trip=q.trip||{};q.trip.mode='car';q.trip.from=from;q.trip.to=to;q.trip.ride=c.id;clCarGoTo(q,c,from)}
 if(c.ph!=='boarding')return p.st!=='go';
 clLog(p.id+' יוצא לרכב '+c.id+' ('+c.party.length+' אנשים)');return true}
function clCarDoorPt(c,i){const h=c.v?c.v.heading:c.h,lx=Math.sin(h),ly=-Math.cos(h),fx=Math.cos(h),fy=Math.sin(h),s=i%2?-1:1;return{x:c.x+lx*s*15+fx*(i>1?-8:4),y:c.y+ly*s*15+fy*(i>1?-8:4)}}
function clCarGoTo(q,c,from){const i=c.party.indexOf(q),dp=clCarDoorPt(c,i);if(from&&!q.shown)clDoorOut(q,from);
 if(Math.hypot(dp.x-q.x,dp.y-q.y)<160&&clLineClear(q.x,q.y,dp.x,dp.y)){q.path=[dp];q.pi=0;q.st='walk';q.after='car-in';return}
 const inY=!!clYard(dp.x,dp.y),att=inY?null:clAttach(dp.x,dp.y,200);if((att||inY)&&clWalkTo(q,dp,att,'car-in'))return;q.trip.carFail=1;clCarAbort(c,q)}
/* no way to the car on foot (never across a road): the trip is off — whoever already sat in the car gets out, everyone goes back in */
function clCarAbort(c,q){CL.stats.carAbort=(CL.stats.carAbort||0)+1;const P=c.party.slice();c.party=[];if(c.trip&&c.trip.stall)c.trip.stall.res=null;c.trip=null;c.ph='park';
 P.forEach((r,j)=>{const from=r.trip&&r.trip.from;r.trip={mode:'walk',from,to:from,t0:CL.t};if(r.st==='car'){const dp=clCarDoorPt(c,j);clShow(r,dp.x,dp.y);CL.stats.carOut++;clEv('רכב-יציאה',r,dp.x,dp.y)}
  if(r.shown){if(!from||!clWalkTo(r,from,from.att,'door'))clStranded(r)}else if(from){r.st='in';r.at=from;r.trip=null;r.nextT=CL.t+60}})}
function clCarBoard(p){const c=CL.carById[p.trip&&p.trip.ride];if(!c||c.ph!=='boarding'||!c.party.includes(p)){CL.stats.carMissed=(CL.stats.carMissed||0)+1;const to=p.trip&&p.trip.to;p.trip={mode:'walk',to,t0:CL.t};if(!to||!clWalkTo(p,to,to.att,to.k==='gate'?'gate':'door'))clStranded(p);return}clHide(p);p.st='car';p.x=c.x;p.y=c.y;CL.stats.carIn++;clEv('רכב-כניסה',p,c.x,c.y);
 if(c.party.every(q=>q.st==='car')){c.ph='ready';c.readyT=CL.t}}
/* the parked car becomes the moving one: the same id, the same place (the parked one is hidden in the same step) */
/* the aisle of A3-P: one car at a time backs or turns out of its stall, in the order they were ready */
function clAisleFree(c){const K2=c2AisleKey(c,false);if(K2){for(const q of CL.cars){if(q===c)continue;if(q.v&&q.v.clOff&&c2AisleKey(q,false)===K2)return false;if(q.v&&(q.ph==='arrived'||(q.ph==='road'&&c2NearStop(q,260)))&&c2AisleKey(q,true)===K2)return false;   /* p730: and one that is about to arrive (it would wait in the lane, and the road behind it) */if(q.ph==='ready'&&!q.v&&c2AisleKey(q,false)===K2&&q.readyT<c.readyT)return false}return true}
 if(c.where!=='A3P')return true;for(const q of CL.cars)if(q!==c&&q.v&&q.where==='A3P'&&(q.ph==='out'||q.ph==='merge'||q.ph==='enter'))return false;for(const q of CL.cars)if(q!==c&&q.v&&q.ph==='in'&&q.trip&&q.trip.lotTo==='A3P')return false;return true}
function clCarDepart(c){const o=allParkedCars().find(q=>q.id===c.id);const v={id:c.id,asset:c.asset,ref:c.ref,kind:'civilian',label:'רכב',edgeId:c.where==='home'&&c.alley?c.alley.edge:c.where==='C2M'?C2M_LOT.outEdge:c.spot?c.spot.edge:CL_A3P.edge,dirSign:1,t:.5,lane:0,lanePref:0,laneTarget:0,x:c.x,y:c.y,heading:c.h,speed:0,targetSpeed:92,wait:false,hop:0,stuck:0,ghost:0,plan:null,runKey:null,turn:null,clOff:true,cl:c};

/* ---- the ways of the car off the road: out of the drive / the stall, and in ---- */
function clBez(P0,P1,P2,P3,n){const out=[];for(let i=0;i<=n;i++){const t=i/n,a=(1-t)**3,b=3*(1-t)**2*t,c=3*(1-t)*t*t,d=t**3;out.push([a*P0[0]+b*P1[0]+c*P2[0]+d*P3[0],a*P0[1]+b*P1[1]+c*P2[1]+d*P3[1]])}return out}
function clLeg(pts,rev){return{P:lgPath(pts),rev:!!rev}}
function clLanePt(edge,dir,x,y,ahead){const e=byEdge[edge],A=byNode[e.a],B=byNode[e.b],L=Math.hypot(B.x-A.x,B.y-A.y),u=((x-A.x)*(B.x-A.x)+(y-A.y)*(B.y-A.y))/(L*L),t0=dir>0?u:1-u,t=Math.max(.03,Math.min(.97,t0+(ahead||0)/L));const p=trafficEdgePoint(edge,dir,t,0);return{x:p.x,y:p.y,heading:p.heading,t}}
/* out: the legs before the road (the drive / the stall and the aisle, up to the kerb or the mouth of the car park) — then the car waits there for a gap,
   and only then the committed legs into the lane (clLegsEnter): a car never stands half in a lane waiting */
function clLegsOut(c){if(c.where==='home'&&c.alley)return c2AlleyOut(c);if(c.where==='C2M')return c2LotOut(c);const h=c.h,hx=Math.cos(h),hy=Math.sin(h);
 if(c.where==='home'){const S=c.spot,tr={x:-S.uy*S.side,y:S.ux*S.side},e=byEdge[S.edge],A=byNode[e.a],hw=(TYPES[e.cls]||TYPES.local).width/2;   /* tr: from the road toward the drive */
  const along=(c.x-A.x)*S.ux+(c.y-A.y)*S.uy,K={x:A.x+S.ux*along+tr.x*(hw+26),y:A.y+S.uy*along+tr.y*(hw+26)};c.K=K;c.facing=hx*(-tr.x)+hy*(-tr.y)>.3;
  const J=clLanePt(S.edge,S.outDir,c.x,c.y,S.ahead||(c.facing?52:30));c.join=J;
  if(c.facing&&Math.hypot(K.x-c.x,K.y-c.y)>2)return[clLeg([[c.x,c.y],[K.x,K.y]])];return[]}
 const D=CL_A3P,st=c.stall,xo=D.aisleOut,legs=[];const J=clLanePt(D.edge,-1,D.joinX,2550,0);c.join=J;c.K={x:xo,y:D.mouthY};const nose=(st.side==='W'?hx>.5:hx<-.5);   /* nose toward the aisle */
 if(nose)legs.push(clLeg(clBez([c.x,c.y],[c.x+hx*30,c.y],[xo,c.y-4],[xo,c.y+34],14)));
 else legs.push(clLeg(clBez([c.x,c.y],[c.x-hx*30,c.y],[xo,c.y+6],[xo,c.y-30],14),true),clLeg([[xo,c.y-30],[xo,c.y+34]]));
 legs.push(clLeg([[xo,c.y+34],[xo,D.mouthY]]));return legs}
function clLegsEnter(c){if((c.where==='home'&&c.alley)||c.where==='C2M')return c2Enter(c);const J=c.join,jx=Math.cos(J.heading),jy=Math.sin(J.heading);
 if(c.where==='home'){const S=c.spot,K=c.K;
  if(c.facing){const tr={x:-S.uy*S.side,y:S.ux*S.side};return[clLeg(clBez([K.x,K.y],[K.x-tr.x*26,K.y-tr.y*26],[J.x-jx*36,J.y-jy*36],[J.x,J.y],16))]}
  /* nose in: back out into the near lane, then forward */
  const hx=Math.cos(c.h),hy=Math.sin(c.h),back=[c.x-hx*34,c.y-hy*34],R=clLanePt(S.edge,S.outDir,c.x,c.y,-30);return[clLeg(clBez([c.x,c.y],back,[R.x+jx*30,R.y+jy*30],[R.x,R.y],16),true),clLeg([[R.x,R.y],[J.x,J.y]])]}
 const M=c.K;return[clLeg(clBez([M.x,M.y],[M.x,M.y+46],[J.x-46,J.y],[J.x,J.y],14))]}
function clLegsIn(c){if(c.trip.lotTo==='home'&&c.alley)return c2AlleyIn(c);if(c.trip.lotTo==='C2M')return c2LotIn(c);const v=c.v,hx=Math.cos(v.heading),hy=Math.sin(v.heading);
 if(c.trip.lotTo==='home'){const S=c.spot,tr={x:-S.uy*S.side,y:S.ux*S.side},px=c.x0,py=c.y0;   /* forward in, the nose toward the house */
  return[clLeg(clBez([v.x,v.y],[v.x+hx*40,v.y+hy*40],[px-tr.x*40,py-tr.y*40],[px,py],18))]}
 const D=CL_A3P,st=c.trip.stall,xi=D.aisleIn;return[clLeg([[v.x,v.y],...clBez([v.x,v.y],[v.x+hx*40,v.y],[xi,D.mouthY+40],[xi,D.mouthY],14).slice(1),[xi,st.y+34],...clBez([xi,st.y+34],[xi,st.y+8],[st.side==='W'?xi-30:xi+30,st.y],[st.x,st.y],14).slice(1)])]}
/* stepping the car on its own way (off the road network): the bodies of the others stop it */
function clCarBlocked(c,x,y,h){const v=c.v;let me;try{me=vehicleCollisionShape(v.asset,v.ref,x,y,h)}catch(e){return null}const rev=c.legs&&c.legs[c.li]&&c.legs[c.li].rev?-1:1,fx=Math.cos(h)*rev,fy=Math.sin(h)*rev,committed=c.ph==='enter'||c.ph==='in';
 for(const o of TRAFFIC_CARS){if(o===v||Math.abs(o.x-x)>120||Math.abs(o.y-y)>120)continue;const ax=(o.x-v.x)*fx+(o.y-v.y)*fy;if(ax<-6)continue;
  /* p730: two cars of the city that stop each other (two villas across the street, both turning in) — the one with the smaller id goes first, the other waits for it */
  if(o.cl&&o.cl.by===c.id&&(o.cl.wt||0)>.5&&c.id<o.cl.id){CL.stats.yieldPair=(CL.stats.yieldPair||0)+1;continue}
  /* in the lane (committed): the road cars wait for it (they see its body) — it stops only for what is right ahead in its way */
  if(committed&&!o.clOff){const lat=Math.abs(-(o.x-v.x)*fy+(o.y-v.y)*fx);if(ax<10||lat>16)continue}try{if(vehicleBodiesOverlap(me,trafficVehicleShape(o),1))return o.id}catch(e){}}
 try{if(PlayerProfile.mode==='vehicle'&&Math.abs(PlayerCar.x-x)<120&&Math.abs(PlayerCar.y-y)<120&&vehicleBodiesOverlap(me,trafficVehicleShape(PlayerCar),1))return 'PLAYER'}catch(e){}
 try{if(PlayerProfile.mode!=='vehicle'&&Math.hypot(PlayerPed.x-x,PlayerPed.y-y)<22)return 'PLAYER-PED'}catch(e){}return null}
function clCarLegs(c,dt){const L=c.legs[c.li];if(!L)return true;const v=c.v,room=L.P.total-c.s,vmax=L.rev?12:(c.ph==='in'?24:28),want=Math.min(vmax,Math.sqrt(60*Math.max(0,room+(c.li<c.legs.length-1?30:0)))+3);v.speed=Math.min(want,(v.speed||0)+30*dt);
 const ns=Math.min(L.P.total,c.s+v.speed*dt),p=lgPose(L.P,ns),h=L.rev?p.heading+Math.PI:p.heading;if(c.wt>14){c.passT=CL.t+2;c.wt=0;CL.stats.legPass=(CL.stats.legPass||0)+1}const hit=CL.t<(c.passT||0)?null:clCarBlocked(c,p.x,p.y,h);
 if(hit){v.speed=0;v.wait=true;c.wt+=dt;c.by=hit;return false}c.wt=0;c.by=null;v.wait=false;c.s=ns;v.x=p.x;v.y=p.y;v.heading=lgTurn(v.heading,h,dt);c.x=v.x;c.y=v.y;
 if(ns>=L.P.total-.05){c.li++;c.s=0;if(c.li<c.legs.length&&c.legs[c.li].rev!==L.rev)v.speed=0}return c.li>=c.legs.length}
